sentences.en: In 2011, the body of a woman was discovered in a California vineyard.
sentences.zh: 2011年，加利福尼亚州的一处葡萄园内发现了一具女性尸体。

sentences.en: She had been decapitated, and her body had been drained of blood.
sentences.zh: 她被斩首，体内的血液也被放干。

sentences.en: It appeared her killer had gone to extraordinary lengths to conceal her identity.
sentences.zh: 凶手似乎费尽心机来掩盖她的身份。

sentences.en: For more than a decade, she was known only as Jane Doe.
sentences.zh: 十多年来，她一直被称为无名女尸。

sentences.en: Then, detectives finally learned her name, Ada.
sentences.zh: 随后，侦探们终于得知了她的名字——艾达。

sentences.en: But identifying her only made this bizarre murder even more perplexing.
sentences.zh: 但确认她的身份后，这起离奇的谋杀案反而变得更加扑朔迷离。

sentences.en: Ada is the new series from Casefile Presents, available now wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 《艾达》是“档案档案呈献”推出的全新系列，各大播客平台现已上线。

sentences.en: please see the show notes for this episode on your app or on our website.
sentences.zh: 请在您使用的应用上或我们的网站上查看本期节目的shownotes。

sentences.en: 18-year-old Zeb Quinn started working part-time at the Hendersonville Road Walmart store in
sentences.zh: 18岁的泽布·奎恩开始在北卡罗来纳州阿什维尔市

sentences.en: Asheville, North Carolina as a means to make money during high school.
sentences.zh: 亨德森维尔路的沃尔玛超市做兼职，以此作为高中期间赚取零花钱的途径。

sentences.en: He enjoyed the job so much that he ended up staying on after graduation.
sentences.zh: 他非常喜欢这份工作，以至于毕业后选择继续留下来。

sentences.en: Zeb had a learning disorder which had caused some difficulties in school and he'd always struggled to fit in.
sentences.zh: 泽布患有学习障碍，这导致他在学校遇到了一些困难，而且他一直很难融入集体。

sentences.en: But at Walmart, his friendly nature, strong work ethic and dependability ensured he was well-liked by his co-workers.
sentences.zh: 但在沃尔玛，他友善的性格、强烈的工作责任感和可靠性让他深受同事们的喜爱。

sentences.en: Zeb had earned a reputation as a valued member of the electronics department team.
sentences.zh: 泽布赢得了电器部团队中坚力量的美誉。

sentences.en: On days where he wasn't rostered on, he often stopped by the store just to drop breakfast off to his colleagues.
sentences.zh: 在没有排班的日子里，他经常顺路去店里给同事们送早餐。

sentences.en: Zeb's mum joked that he spent more time at Walmart than he did at home.
sentences.zh: 泽布的妈妈开玩笑说，他在沃尔玛待的时间比在家还要长。

sentences.en: In the two and a half years Zeb had been working there, he'd never once called in sick.
sentences.zh: 在泽布工作的两年半里，他一次也没有请过病假。

sentences.en: Zeb's supervisor, Paddy Andrick, was particularly fond of the 18-year-old.
sentences.zh: 泽布的主管帕迪·安德里克特别喜欢这个18岁的男孩。

sentences.en: Despite their age difference, the two got along well.
sentences.zh: 尽管两人存在年龄差距，但他们相处得很好。

sentences.en: Every morning, Zeb called Paddy at work just to chat and make sure he'd done everything Paddy needed him to do.
sentences.zh: 每天早上，泽布都会在工作时给帕迪打电话，只是为了闲聊，并确保自己完成了帕迪需要他做的一切。

sentences.en: Paddy was therefore puzzled when she received a phone call from Zeb's mother, Denise, on Monday
sentences.zh: 因此，当帕迪在2000年1月3日星期一

sentences.en: January 3, 2000, asking if she knew where Zeb could be.
sentences.zh: 接到泽布的母亲丹尼斯打来的电话，询问她是否知道泽布在哪里时，她感到很困惑。

sentences.en: Denise said that her son hadn't returned home after his shift the previous night and she was getting worried.
sentences.zh: 丹尼斯说她的儿子前一天晚上值班结束后没有回家，她开始担心起来。

sentences.en: Paddy hadn't seen or heard from Zeb since he clocked off around 9pm.
sentences.zh: 自晚上9点左右打卡下班以来，帕迪就没见过泽布，也没有他的消息。

sentences.en: She told Denise she'd contact her right away if she heard anything.
sentences.zh: 她告诉丹尼斯，如果听到什么消息，她会立刻联系她。

sentences.en: The following day of Tuesday January 4, Zeb was rostered to work the afternoon shift at Walmart.
sentences.zh: 第二天，即1月4日星期二，泽布被安排在沃尔玛上下午班。

sentences.en: His family hoped he'd show up safe and well with a worthwhile explanation for his brief disappearance.
sentences.zh: 他的家人希望他能平安无事地出现，并对他的短暂失踪给出一个合理的解释。

sentences.en: At around 2pm, Paddy Andrick was manning the electronics desk when the phone rang.
sentences.zh: 下午2点左右，帕迪·安德里克正在电器柜台值班，电话铃响了。

sentences.en: Hi, this is Zeb, the caller said.
sentences.zh: “嗨，我是泽布，”打电话的人说。

sentences.en: I won't be in today.
sentences.zh: “我今天不去了。”

sentences.en: Patty knew Zeb's voice well.
sentences.zh: 帕蒂很熟悉泽布的声音。

sentences.en: She didn't know who the caller was, but she was certain of one thing.
sentences.zh: 她不知道打电话的人是谁，但她有一点可以确定。

sentences.en: It wasn't Zeb Quinn.
sentences.zh: 那不是泽布·奎恩。

sentences.en: Denise Quinn was incredibly close with her son Zeb, whom she affectionately described as a mama's boy.
sentences.zh: 丹尼斯·奎恩和她的儿子泽布关系极其亲密，她深情地称他为“妈妈的乖儿子”。

sentences.en: After finishing high school, he willingly chose to remain living at home with his mother, just the two of them.
sentences.zh: 高中毕业后，他心甘情愿地选择继续和母亲住在一起，家里只有他们两个人。

sentences.en: Zeb's parents had divorced when he was a toddler and his older sister had recently gotten married and moved in with her husband.
sentences.zh: 泽布的父母在他蹒跚学步时就离婚了，他的姐姐最近刚结婚并搬去和丈夫同住。

sentences.en: Zeb didn't have many close friends his own age to talk to, but he never hesitated to confide in his mother.
sentences.zh: 泽布没有多少同龄的亲密朋友可以倾诉，但他从不犹豫向母亲吐露心声。

sentences.en: So when Zeb failed to return home from work on the night of Sunday
sentences.zh: 因此，当泽布在2000年1月2日星期日

sentences.en: January 2, 2000, Denise sensed something was wrong.
sentences.zh: 的晚上没有按时从工作地点回家时，丹尼斯预感到出事了。

sentences.en: He usually came straight home, and if he didn't, he always contacted his mother to let her know where he was and what he was doing.
sentences.zh: 他通常会直接回家，如果没有，他总是会联系母亲，告诉她他在哪里、在做什么。

sentences.en: Denise told herself that Zeb had probably just stopped off somewhere to play pool, a new found hobby of his.
sentences.zh: 丹尼斯安慰自己说，泽布可能只是在什么地方逗留打台球去了，这是他新近培养的爱好。

sentences.en: His father, who owned a bar across town, had recently given him his own pool queue, and Zeb was eager to use it.
sentences.zh: 他的父亲在城另一头经营一家酒吧，最近刚送了他一根专属台球杆，泽布正急着呢。

sentences.en: Zeb didn't have a mobile phone, but he took his pager with him everywhere.
sentences.zh: 泽布没有手机，但他去哪儿都随身带着寻呼机。

sentences.en: A popular telecommunications device at the time, a call to a pager would leave a digital message for that person, typically in the form of a phone number.
sentences.zh: 这是当时流行的一种电信设备，呼叫寻呼机会给该人留下数字信息，通常是电话号码的形式。

sentences.en: This would alert the user that someone was trying to reach them.
sentences.zh: 这将提醒用户有人正试图联系他们。

sentences.en: Over the following hours, Denise paged Zeb several times.
sentences.zh: 在接下来的几个小时里，丹尼斯给泽布发了好几次寻呼。

sentences.en: He didn't respond.
sentences.zh: 他没有回复。

sentences.en: After a night of broken sleep, Denise spent all of Monday calling Zeb's friends and relatives.
sentences.zh: 经过一夜断断续续的睡眠，丹尼斯在周一花了一整天时间给泽布的朋友和亲戚打电话。

sentences.en: No one had heard from him or had any idea where he could be.
sentences.zh: 没有人见过他，也没有人知道他在哪里。

sentences.en: When he still hadn't gotten in touch that evening, Denise called the police to report her son missing.
sentences.zh: 当那天晚上他仍然没有联系她时，丹尼斯打电话给警察报告她儿子失踪了。

sentences.en: As Zeb was 18 years old, he was free to come and go as he pleased.
sentences.zh: 由于泽布已经18岁了，他可以自由地来去。

sentences.en: They reassured Denise he was likely just out, doing what teenage boys do, and would show up soon.
sentences.zh: 他们向丹尼斯保证，他可能只是出去做十几岁男孩常做的事，很快就会出现。

sentences.en: When Zeb's work supervisor, Patty Andrick, received a call on Tuesday afternoon from an unfamiliar male claiming to be Zeb, she sprung into action.
sentences.zh: 当泽布的工作主管帕蒂·安德里克在周二下午接到一个自称是泽布的陌生男子的电话时，她立刻采取了行动。

sentences.en: Patty began asking the caller work-related questions that only Zeb would know the answers to.
sentences.zh: 帕蒂开始向来电者询问只有泽布才知道答案的工作相关问题。

sentences.en: The caller stumbled to respond before abruptly ending the call.
sentences.zh: 来电者支支吾吾地回答，随后便粗暴地挂断了电话。

sentences.en: Paddy immediately dialed star 69.
sentences.zh: 帕迪立即拨打了*69。

sentences.en: In the United States, this call return feature automatically redials the last number that called through to a phone line.
sentences.zh: 在美国，这个呼叫返回功能会自动重拨呼入电话线路的最后一个号码。

sentences.en: A woman answered,
sentences.zh: 一个女人接了电话，

sentences.en: Volvo construction equipment, she said.
sentences.zh: “沃尔沃建筑设备，”她说。

sentences.en: How may I help you?
sentences.zh: “有什么我可以帮您的吗？”

sentences.en: Zeb Quinn had no connection to the
sentences.zh: 泽布·奎恩与

sentences.en: Volvo plant, but one of his Walmart co-workers did.
sentences.zh: 沃尔沃工厂没有任何联系，但他的一位沃尔沃同事有。

sentences.en: 22-year-old Robert Owens, who went by his middle name of Jason worked part-time at both businesses.
sentences.zh: 22岁的罗伯特·欧文斯（他用的是中间名贾森）在这两家企业都做兼职。

sentences.en: Colleagues had seen Zeb and Jason talking to one another just before Zeb clocked off on the night he disappeared.
sentences.zh: 就在泽布失踪当晚打卡下班前，同事们曾看到泽布和贾森在交谈。

sentences.en: Zeb was in the market to buy a new car.
sentences.zh: 泽布正想买辆新车。

sentences.en: Jason said he knew of one for sale that Zeb might be interested in.
sentences.zh: 贾森说他知道有一辆车在出售，泽布可能会感兴趣。

sentences.en: After learning about the call made to Patty Andrick, police officers went to speak to Jason
sentences.zh: 在得知打给帕蒂·安德里克的电话后，警官们前去与贾森·

sentences.en: Owens.
sentences.zh: 欧文斯交谈。

sentences.en: He told them that after Zeb finished work on Sunday night, the pair met in the Walmart parking lot.
sentences.zh: 他告诉他们，周日晚泽布下班后，两人在沃尔玛停车场碰了面。

sentences.en: The car Jason thought Zeb might like was a Mitsubishi Eclipse.
sentences.zh: 贾森认为泽布可能会喜欢的那辆车是一辆三菱日蚀。

sentences.en: It was parked out on Leicester
sentences.zh: 它停在大约15英里以北的莱斯特

sentences.en: Highway, roughly 15 miles north.
sentences.zh: 高速公路旁。

sentences.en: Jason had offered to drive out to show Zeb where it was.
sentences.zh: 贾森主动提出开车带泽布去看车。

sentences.en: Zeb agreed
sentences.zh: 泽布同意了。

sentences.en: He got in to his light blue Mazda protégé and tailed Jason's Ford pickup truck
sentences.zh: 他坐进他那辆浅蓝色的马自达Protege轿车，尾随着贾森的福特皮卡。

sentences.en: The two made a quick stop at a gas station on Hendersonville Road to grab a drink before hitting the road
sentences.zh: 两人在亨德森维尔路的一家加油站短暂停留，买了一杯饮料，然后便上了路。

sentences.en: According to Jason, a few minutes later, Zeb started flashing his headlights
sentences.zh: 据贾森说，几分钟后，泽布开始闪烁大灯。

sentences.en: Taking this as a sign to pull over, Jason stopped on Long Shoals Road, just around the corner from a high school
sentences.zh: 贾森将此视为靠边停车的信号，便停在了离一所高中只有几个拐角远的朗肖尔斯路上。

sentences.en: Zeb pulled up behind him and said he'd just received a page and had to make a call.
sentences.zh: 泽布把车停在他后面，说他刚收到一条寻呼，必须打个电话。

sentences.en: He asked Jason if he had a cell phone he could use.
sentences.zh: 他问贾森有没有手机可以借用。

sentences.en: Jason didn't.
sentences.zh: 贾森没有。

sentences.en: Zeb said he was going to find a payphone and would be back shortly.
sentences.zh: 泽布说他去找个公用电话，一会儿就回来。

sentences.en: Jason told the police that he waited for 10 minutes before Zeb's Mazda reappeared.
sentences.zh: 贾森告诉警方，他等了10分钟，泽布的马自达才重新出现。

sentences.en: By this point, it was around 9.30pm.
sentences.zh: 此时，时间大约是晚上9点半。

sentences.en: As Zeb pulled up behind Jason's truck, he bumped into the back of it.
sentences.zh: 当泽布把车开到贾森的卡车后面时，撞到了卡车的尾部。

sentences.en: According to Jason, Zeb was frantic.
sentences.zh: 据贾森说，泽布当时情绪非常慌乱。

sentences.en: In an obvious rush, he apologised and offered to pay for any damage, but said he needed to cancel their plans.
sentences.zh: 他显然很赶时间，道了歉并提出赔偿任何损失，但说他必须取消他们的计划。

sentences.en: He'd just received another page and had to leave right away.
sentences.zh: 他刚刚收到了另一条寻呼，必须马上离开。

sentences.en: With that, Jason watched as Zeb's Mazda disappeared from view.
sentences.zh: 就这样，贾森看着泽布的马自达消失在视野中。

sentences.en: According to Jason, he had no idea that Zeb never returned home after that.
sentences.zh: 据贾森说，他根本不知道泽布在那之后再也没有回家。

sentences.en: Outside of work, the pair occasionally played pool and went fishing together, but they weren't close friends.
sentences.zh: 除了工作之外，两人偶尔一起打台球、钓鱼，但并不是亲密的朋友。

sentences.en: Jason said he therefore thought nothing of it when Zeb called him on Tuesday morning, asking if he'd do him a favour by calling in sick on his behalf.
sentences.zh: 贾森说，因此当周二早上泽布打电话给他，问他是否能帮个忙替他请病假时，他并没有多想。

sentences.en: Police obtained the CCTV footage from the gas station on Hendersonville Road.
sentences.zh: 警方获取了亨德森维尔路加油站的闭路电视监控录像。

sentences.en: At 9.14pm on Sunday January 2, the footage captured Jason Owens entering the store.
sentences.zh: 1月2日星期日晚上9点14分，录像拍到贾森·欧文斯进入商店。

sentences.en: Ten seconds later, Zeb Quinn entered behind him.
sentences.zh: 十秒钟后，泽布·奎恩跟在他身后走了进去。

sentences.en: The two young men purchased soft drinks before leaving via the same door.
sentences.zh: 两名年轻男子购买了软饮料，然后从同一扇门离开。

sentences.en: Two minutes later, both of their vehicles could be seen heading in the direction of Long Shoals Road, just like Jason Owens had described.
sentences.zh: 两分钟后，可以看到他们两人的车辆朝着朗肖尔斯路方向驶去，正如贾森·欧文斯所描述的那样。

sentences.en: For the police, Jason's story added weight to their belief that Zeb had likely left on his own accord and would show up again soon.
sentences.zh: 对警方来说，贾森的说法进一步加深了他们的信念，即泽布很可能是自愿离开的，很快就会再次出现。

sentences.en: His mother Denise wanted to believe this too, but she wasn't so sure.
sentences.zh: 他的母亲丹尼斯也希望相信这一点，但她并不十分确信。

sentences.en: Not only would it be completely out of character for Zeb to take off unannounced, he hadn't taken anything with him that indicated an intention to be gone for any amount of time.
sentences.zh: 不告而别完全不符合泽布的性格，而且他也没有带走任何表明他打算离开一段时间的物品。

sentences.en: When he'd left Walmart, he was still dressed in his work uniform and didn't have a coat or any other change of clothes,
sentences.zh: 当他离开沃尔玛时，他依然穿着工作制服，没有穿外套或携带任何换洗衣物，

sentences.en: despite the January weather in North Carolina getting bitterly cold.
sentences.zh: 尽管北卡罗来纳州一月的冬天冷得刺骨。

sentences.en: Zeb also wore contact lenses but had left his contact solution at home.
sentences.zh: 泽布还戴着隐形眼镜，却把护理液留在了家里。

sentences.en: Denise knew there was no way Zeb would have run away for good or considered suicide.
sentences.zh: 丹尼斯知道泽布绝不可能一去不复返，也绝不会考虑自杀。

sentences.en: He was a happy young man who enjoyed his life and expressed excitement about the future.
sentences.zh: 他是一个快乐的年轻人，热爱生活，并对未来充满期待。

sentences.en: He'd recently purchased a new DVD player and satellite television system and was looking forward to setting them up.
sentences.zh: 他最近刚买了一台新的DVD播放器和卫星电视系统，正期待着把它们安装好。

sentences.en: Zeb was also taking classes at the local community
sentences.zh: 泽布还在当地的社区

sentences.en: College and was enrolled in the Reserve Officers' Training Corps.
sentences.zh: 学院上课，并注册加入了预备役军官训练团。

sentences.en: While he loved his job at Walmart, his dream was to one day join the armed forces as a commissioned officer.
sentences.zh: 虽然他热爱在沃尔玛的工作，但他的梦想是有朝一日能加入武装部队成为一名军官。

sentences.en: Jason Owens told police that Zeb didn't mention who had been paging him so urgently.
sentences.zh: 贾森·欧文斯告诉警方，泽布没有提及是谁在如此紧急地呼叫他。

sentences.en: But those who knew Zeb well had their suspicions.
sentences.zh: 但那些了解泽布的人却心存疑虑。

sentences.en: Denise Quinn's boyfriend,
sentences.zh: 丹尼斯·奎恩的男友

sentences.en: Costa, ran a diner-style restaurant in Asheville called Costa's Kitchen.
sentences.zh: 科斯塔在阿什维尔经营着一家名为“科斯塔厨房”的美式快餐店。

sentences.en: Zeb had a close relationship with Costa and often stopped by the restaurant to order his favourite menu item, the chicken tenders.
sentences.zh: 泽布和科斯塔关系密切，经常顺路去餐厅点他最喜欢的菜单选项——鸡柳。

sentences.en: In December 1999, just weeks before he disappeared,
sentences.zh: 1999年12月，就在他失踪前几周，

sentences.en: Zeb was at Costa's kitchen when he struck up a conversation with a young woman named Misty Taylor.
sentences.zh: 泽布在科斯塔厨房时，和一个名叫米斯蒂·泰勒的年轻女子搭上了话。

sentences.en: Misty's mother worked at the restaurant alongside Zeb's aunt.
sentences.zh: 米斯蒂的母亲和泽布的姑姑一同在那家餐厅工作。

sentences.en: Misty and Zeb hit it off and became fast friends.
sentences.zh: 米斯蒂和泽布一见如故，很快成了好朋友。

sentences.en: But to those close to Zeb, it was obvious that his feelings went beyond just friendship.
sentences.zh: 但在了解泽布的人看来，很明显他的感情已经超越了单纯的友谊。

sentences.en: Zeb became infatuated with 19-year-old Misty, talking about her non-stop to anyone who would listen.
sentences.zh: 泽布迷恋上了19岁的米斯蒂，在任何愿意听他说话的人面前都不停地谈论她。

sentences.en: The two began spending more and more time together, playing pool and hanging out at the mall.
sentences.zh: 两人开始花越来越多的时间在一起，打台球并在商场闲逛。

sentences.en: The problem was, Misty was already in a long-term relationship with a man named
sentences.zh: 问题是，米斯蒂已经和一个名叫

sentences.en: Wesley Smith.
sentences.zh: 韦斯利·史密斯的男子保持着长期恋爱关系。

sentences.en: The two had a baby together.
sentences.zh: 两人甚至还有一个孩子。

sentences.en: Zeb's family and friends urged him to cut ties with
sentences.zh: 泽布的家人和朋友敦促他与

sentences.en: Misty, but Zeb didn't listen.
sentences.zh: 米斯蒂断绝联系，但泽布没有听取。

sentences.en: Misty had apparently confided in him that Wesley had a jealous streak and was abusive towards her, and Zeb was determined to help her escape their relationship.
sentences.zh: 显然米斯蒂曾向他倾诉，称韦斯利有嫉妒心并且对她施暴，泽布决心帮她摆脱这段关系。

sentences.en: By late December, some of Zeb's co-workers noted that he seemed nervous.
sentences.zh: 到12月下旬，泽布的一些同事注意到他显得很紧张。

sentences.en: Wesley had found out about the pair's newfound friendship and he wasn't happy.
sentences.zh: 韦斯利发现了两人新建立的友谊，对此非常不满。

sentences.en: Word allegedly got out that
sentences.zh: 据称有传言称

sentences.en: Wesley and his friends warned Zeb to stay away.
sentences.zh: 韦斯利和他的朋友警告泽布离远点。

sentences.en: Zeb and Misty stayed in contact regardless, but Wesley soon found out about that too.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，泽布和米斯蒂仍然保持着联系，但韦斯利很快也发现了这一点。

sentences.en: According to one of Zeb's co-workers, on the day he went missing, he mentioned that someone had threatened his life.
sentences.zh: 据泽布的一位同事透露，在他失踪当天，他曾提到有人威胁他的生命。

sentences.en: When Zeb had first failed to return home, Misty Taylor was one of the first people his mother called.
sentences.zh: 当泽布最初没有回家时，米斯蒂·泰勒是他的母亲打电话联系的第一批人之一。

sentences.en: Misty said she hadn't heard from Zeb and had no idea where he could be.
sentences.zh: 米斯蒂说她没有泽布的消息，也不知道他在哪里。

sentences.en: According to Misty, on the night Zeb disappeared, she and her boyfriend Wesley had been having dinner at her mother's house, an alibi that checked out.
sentences.zh: 据米斯蒂说，在泽布失踪的当晚，她和男友韦斯利一直在她母亲家吃晚饭，这个不在场证明得到了证实。

sentences.en: For Zeb's loved ones, this raised the question.
sentences.zh: 对于泽布的亲人来说，这引发了一个问题。

sentences.en: If Misty didn't send Zeb the urgent page, then who did?
sentences.zh: 如果米斯蒂没有给泽布发送紧急寻呼，那会是谁呢？

sentences.en: As the days continued to pass with no word from Zeb, local newspapers started appealing for anyone with information to come forward.
sentences.zh: 随着日子一天天过去，依然没有泽布的消息，当地报纸开始呼吁知情者挺身而出。

sentences.en: Citizens were urged to be on the lookout for the 18-year-old, who was described as 5 foot
sentences.zh: 警方敦促市民留意这名18岁的年轻人，他的身高据描述为5英尺

sentences.en: 10 and approximately 165 pounds, with grey-blue eyes and short brown hair.
sentences.zh: 10英寸（约1.78米），体重约165磅（约75公斤），拥有灰蓝色的眼睛和短棕发。

sentences.en: He was driving a light blue 1990 model Mazda Protégé Sedan.
sentences.zh: 他驾驶着一辆浅蓝色的1990款马自达Protege轿车。

sentences.en: While police maintained that Zeb's disappearance wasn't being treated as suspicious, Denise Quinn grew more and more concerned.
sentences.zh: 尽管警方坚称泽布的失踪不作为可疑案件处理，但丹尼斯·奎恩却越来越担忧。

sentences.en: At the very least, her son was out there without a coat and she worried about how cold he could be.
sentences.zh: 至少她的儿子在外面连外套都没穿，她担心他会有多冷。

sentences.en: Denise told the Asheville Citizen Times, I just want to know my son is okay.
sentences.zh: 丹尼斯告诉《阿什维尔公民时报》：“我只想知道我的儿子是否安好。”

sentences.en: It's just very weird.
sentences.zh: “这实在是太诡异了。”

sentences.en: It's too weird.
sentences.zh: “太诡异了。”

sentences.en: Adding to the strangeness of the case, police looked into Jason Owens and discovered that on the morning of Monday January 3, he called his supervisor at the Volvo plant to say he
sentences.zh: 为了增加案件的离奇色彩，警方调查了贾森·欧文斯，发现他在1月3日星期一早上给沃尔沃工厂的主管打电话说他

sentences.en: couldn't make it into work.
sentences.zh: 无法去上班。

sentences.en: He claimed he'd been in a car accident and was receiving treatment at the urgent care centre on Hendersonville Road.
sentences.zh: 他声称自己遭遇了一场车祸，正在亨德森维尔路的紧急护理中心接受治疗。

sentences.en: Records confirmed that Jason Owens had checked himself into the centre at 9.40am, just over 12 hours after Zeb Quinn was last seen alive.
sentences.zh: 记录证实，杰森·欧文斯于上午 9 点 40 分自行前往该中心登记入住，此时距离泽布·奎因最后一次被人看到还活着刚过去 12 个多小时。

sentences.en: He was treated for a head wound and fractured ribs, injuries that weren't consistent with
sentences.zh: 他因头部受伤和肋骨骨折接受了治疗，这些伤势与

sentences.en: Zeb Quinn rear-ending his car.
sentences.zh: 泽布·奎因追尾他的车这一情况不符。

sentences.en: When speaking to police, Jason claimed that this was a separate incident entirely.
sentences.zh: 在与警方交谈时，杰森声称这是一起完全独立的事件。

sentences.en: He said that several hours after his final encounter with Zeb, he was driving past
sentences.zh: 他说，在他最后一次与泽布见面几个小时后，他在

sentences.en: the Waffle House restaurant on Long Shoals Road in the pre-dawn light when he collided with another vehicle.
sentences.zh: 黎明前的微光中驾车驶过朗肖尔斯路上的华夫饼屋餐厅时，与另一辆车相撞了。

sentences.en: Police checked their records.
sentences.zh: 警方查阅了记录。

sentences.en: No accident reports had been filed for the early morning hours of Monday January 3 anywhere in the county.
sentences.zh: 该县任何地方都没有人在 1 月 3 日星期一的清晨时分提交过任何事故报告。

sentences.en: The injuries Jason Owens had been treated for also raised some questions as they weren't typical for a car accident.
sentences.zh: 杰森·欧文斯接受治疗的伤势也引发了一些疑问，因为这些伤势不像车祸中常见的伤。

sentences.en: After giving his initial statement to the police, Jason Owens refused to cooperate any further.
sentences.zh: 在向警方提供最初的陈述后，杰森·欧文斯拒绝进行任何进一步的配合。

sentences.en: Although his behaviour raised suspicions, there was nothing to tie him to Zeb's disappearance.
sentences.zh: 尽管他的行为引起了怀疑，但没有任何证据将他与泽布的失踪联系起来。

sentences.en: In fact, there was still nothing to confirm that Zeb had met with foul play at all.
sentences.zh: 事实上，仍然没有任何证据确认泽布确实遭遇了不测。

sentences.en: His absence continued to be felt wholeheartedly by his loved ones
sentences.zh: 他的挚爱们依然深深地感受着他的缺席

sentences.en: Denise Quinn couldn't ignore Zeb's favourite lounge chair which he typically kicked back on with his dog, Sam
sentences.zh: 丹尼斯·奎因无法忽视泽布最喜欢的躺椅，他通常会和他的狗山姆一起在上面躺着放松

sentences.en: The chair now sat empty
sentences.zh: 椅子现在空着

sentences.en: Sam's whimpers, a constant reminder of the fact that Zeb was gone
sentences.zh: 山姆的呜咽声，不断提醒着人们泽布已经不在了

sentences.en: Then, on January 16, 2000 exactly two weeks to the day since Zeb was last seen
sentences.zh: 然后，在 2000 年 1 月 16 日，也就是泽布最后一次被人看到整整两周的那天

sentences.en: Denise Quinn received a phone call.
sentences.zh: 丹尼斯·奎因接到了一个电话。

sentences.en: Denise worked at the Mission Hospital on McDowell Street in downtown Asheville.
sentences.zh: 丹尼斯在市中心阿什维尔麦克道尔街的教会医院工作。

sentences.en: A younger co-worker of hers had attended the same high school as Zeb and was following the news about his disappearance.
sentences.zh: 她的一位年轻同事和泽布上过同一所高中，并且一直在关注关于他失踪的新闻。

sentences.en: She'd just passed by the Little Pigs BBQ restaurant, which was adjacent to the hospital's parking lot, and noticed a light blue Mazda parked there.
sentences.zh: 她刚刚经过紧邻医院停车场的小猪烧烤餐厅，注意到那里停着一辆浅蓝色的马自达汽车。

sentences.en: She called Denise to let her know that it might be Zeb's
sentences.zh: 她打电话给丹尼斯，告诉她这辆车可能是泽布的

sentences.en: Denise rushed to the little pig's parking lot
sentences.zh: 丹尼斯冲向小猪烧烤的停车场

sentences.en: Sure enough, it was Zeb's Mazda
sentences.zh: 果不其然，那是泽布的马自达

sentences.en: Zeb himself was nowhere to be seen But one look at the vehicle told Denise that something was wrong
sentences.zh: 泽布本人不见踪影，但只需看一眼这辆车，丹尼斯就知道出事了

sentences.en: The headlights were on and the windows were slightly ajar
sentences.zh: 前大灯亮着，车窗微微敞开

sentences.en: On the rear windshield, someone had used what appeared to be pink lipstick to draw a large set of lips with an exclamation mark on either side.
sentences.zh: 在后挡风玻璃上，有人用看起来像是粉红色口红的东西画了一组大大的嘴唇，两边各有一个感叹号。

sentences.en: When police arrived, they opened the car doors to find something completely unexpected inside.
sentences.zh: 当警察到达时，他们打开车门，在车内发现了完全意想不到的东西。

sentences.en: A black Labrador Cross puppy.
sentences.zh: 一只黑色拉布拉多混血幼犬。

sentences.en: The dog appeared to be approximately three months old and was completely unharmed, but nothing about her presence made sense.
sentences.zh: 这只狗看起来大约三个月大，完好无损，但它的出现毫无逻辑。

sentences.en: Zeb didn't own the puppy, nor had he mentioned wanting to get one.
sentences.zh: 泽布没有养过这只小狗，也没有提过想养一只。

sentences.en: Also inside the car were several drink bottles, a plastic hotel keycard, and a men's jacket, which Denise confirmed didn't belong to her son.
sentences.zh: 车内还有几个饮料瓶、一张塑料酒店房卡和一个男士夹克，丹尼斯证实这件夹克不属于她的儿子。

sentences.en: None of these items held any obvious significance or indicated where Zeb could be.
sentences.zh: 这些物品中没有一件具有明显的意义，也没有透露泽布可能在哪里。

sentences.en: His family wondered whether he had intentionally left these clues behind to send some kind of message.
sentences.zh: 他的家人想知道他是否是有意留下这些线索来传达某种信息。

sentences.en: Zeb's grandmother theorised that the drawing of the lips could be his way of sending kisses, and maybe he'd left the puppy there to signify that he was alive and well.
sentences.zh: 泽布的祖母推测，嘴唇的涂鸦可能是他发送飞吻的方式，也许他在那里留下小狗是为了表明他平安无事。

sentences.en: One person even suggested that the puppy was a sign of guilt from whoever had dumped the car.
sentences.zh: 甚至有人提出，这只小狗是抛车者内心有愧的表现。

sentences.en: Perhaps they felt so bad about what happened to Zeb that they left the dog to console his family.
sentences.zh: 也许他们对泽布的遭遇感到非常内疚，所以留下了这只狗来安慰他的家人。

sentences.en: Others thought the puppy had been planted there to ensure the car didn't go unnoticed.
sentences.zh: 其他人则认为，这只小狗是被放在那里的，是为了确保这辆车不会被忽视。

sentences.en: If the abandoned vehicle hadn't sparked attention, a yapping puppy surely would.
sentences.zh: 如果被弃置的车辆没有引起注意，一只狂吠的小狗肯定会引起注意。

sentences.en: The location also raised some questions.
sentences.zh: 车辆的地点也引发了一些疑问。

sentences.en: Zeb's sister Brandy also worked at the Mission Hospital.
sentences.zh: 泽布的姐姐布兰迪也在教会医院工作。

sentences.en: The two siblings were incredibly close.
sentences.zh: 这对姐弟关系极其亲密。

sentences.en: Zeb often called Brandy at the home she shared with her husband and young daughter just to tell her that he loved her.
sentences.zh: 泽布经常给和丈夫及年幼女儿住在一起的布兰迪打电话，只为了告诉她他爱她。

sentences.en: Some wondered if Zeb had intentionally left the car at the Little Pigs restaurant because there was a higher chance that his family would find it.
sentences.zh: 有人想知道泽布是否故意把车停在小猪餐厅，因为他的家人发现这辆车的几率更高。

sentences.en: But Denise Quinn didn't think so.
sentences.zh: 但丹尼斯·奎因并不这么认为。

sentences.en: Zeb knew that his mother and sister typically used the entrance at the other side of the hospital.
sentences.zh: 泽布知道他的母亲和姐姐通常使用医院另一侧的入口。

sentences.en: If he wanted them to find his car, Denise felt there were better places he could have left it.
sentences.zh: 如果他想让她们找到他的车，丹尼斯觉得有更好的地方可以停。

sentences.en: When police examined the vehicle, they realised that the driver's seat had been pulled close to the steering wheel.
sentences.zh: 当警察检查这辆车时，他们意识到驾驶员工座被拉到了靠近方向盘的地方。

sentences.en: Zeb was 5 foot 10 and he typically kept the seat pushed further back.
sentences.zh: 泽布身高 5 英尺 10 英寸，他通常把座位调得靠后一些。

sentences.en: With the seat positioned the way it was, there was no way he could have comfortably driven the car.
sentences.zh: 按照这个座位的摆放位置，他根本不可能舒适地驾驶这辆车。

sentences.en: Whoever it was that had driven the vehicle to the parking lot, it wasn't Zeb Quinn.
sentences.zh: 不管是谁把这辆车开到停车场的，绝对不是泽布·奎因。

sentences.en: The discovery of Zeb's Mazda was a major breakthrough, but the clues left inside only raised more questions.
sentences.zh: 发现泽布的马自达是一个重大突破，但留在车内的线索却引发了更多的疑问。

sentences.en: The hotel keycard was just a blank white card with no information on it.
sentences.zh: 酒店房卡只是一张空白的白卡，上面没有任何信息。

sentences.en: It didn't include the hotel's name, a logo, or guest room number.
sentences.zh: 它没有包含酒店名称、标志或客房号。

sentences.en: Police made inquiries with various accommodation providers, but couldn't determine where the keycard originated from.
sentences.zh: 警方询问了多家住宿服务提供商，但未能确定这张房卡的来源。

sentences.en: No one could figure out where the puppy had come from either.
sentences.zh: 谁也搞不清楚这只小狗是从哪里来的。

sentences.en: Police couldn't even be sure what had been used to draw the lips and exclamation marks on the rear windshield.
sentences.zh: 警方甚至无法确定后挡风玻璃上的嘴唇和感叹号是用什么画的。

sentences.en: It appeared to be lipstick, but one detective told ABC 13 News that it could have also been paint, crayon, or magic marker.
sentences.zh: 看起来像是口红，但一位侦探告诉美国广播公司第 13 台新闻，它也可能是油漆、蜡笔或记号笔。

sentences.en: Staff at the Little Pigs restaurant recalled that the Mazda hadn't been parked there the evening before it was found.
sentences.zh: 小猪餐厅的工作人员回忆说，在被发现的前一天晚上，这辆马自达并没有停在那里。

sentences.en: This, along with the well-being of the puppy, meant it had only been abandoned hours before it was discovered.
sentences.zh: 这一点，再加上小狗良好的精神状态，意味着它是在被发现前几小时才被遗弃的。

sentences.en: There wasn't a single piece of evidence to indicate fair play, nor was there anything to suggest that Zeb had voluntarily run away.
sentences.zh: 没有任何证据表明存在谋杀，也没有任何迹象表明泽布是自愿离家出走。

sentences.en: The Asheville police captain told reporters that they couldn't decide whether the car turning up was a good or bad sign.
sentences.zh: 阿什维尔警察局长告诉记者，他们无法判断这辆车的出现究竟是好兆头还是坏兆头。

sentences.en: Speaking to the Asheville Citizen Times, he commented,
sentences.zh: 在接受《阿什维尔公民时报》采访时，他评论道：

sentences.en: It's hard to say what this indicates.
sentences.zh: 很难说这说明了什么。

sentences.en: If anybody saw that car anywhere, they should let me know.
sentences.zh: 如果有人在任何地方看到过那辆车，应该立刻通知我。

sentences.en: The next day, a couple came forward to report that a few days prior to the car being found, they'd seen a woman driving it around downtown Asheville.
sentences.zh: 第二天，一对夫妇站出来报告说，在汽车被发现前几天，他们曾看到一名女子驾驶它在阿什维尔市中心四处行驶。

sentences.en: The woman appeared to be around 25 to 30 years old, with wavy, light brown hair.
sentences.zh: 这名女子看起来 25 到 30 岁左右，留着波浪状的浅棕色头发。

sentences.en: The couple agreed to help put together a composite sketch of the driver.
sentences.zh: 这对夫妇同意协助绘制驾驶员的体貌拼图。

sentences.en: When police saw it, they couldn't deny the similarities it bore to Misty
sentences.zh: 当警方看到它时，他们无法否认它与米丝蒂的相似之处

sentences.en: Taylor.
sentences.zh: 泰勒。

sentences.en: Misty was questioned, but she denied having driven Zeb's car and maintained that she had no idea where he was or what happened to him.
sentences.zh: 米丝蒂受到了盘问，但她否认自己驾驶过泽布的车，并坚称她不知道他在哪里，也不知道发生了什么事。

sentences.en: With a solid alibi and no concrete evidence to suggest she knew otherwise, police hit a dead end.
sentences.zh: 由于有着坚实的不在场证明，且没有具体证据表明她知情，警方陷入了死胡同。

sentences.en: Zeb's family hired a private detective, but he too remained baffled by the presence of Zeb's vehicle, telling Spin magazine,
sentences.zh: 泽布的家人雇佣了一名私家侦探，但他同样对泽布座驾的出现感到困惑，他在接受《Spin》杂志采访时表示：

sentences.en: It goes against all reason of criminality for the car to be here.
sentences.zh: 这违背了犯罪的所有常理，车怎么会在这里。

sentences.en: It's just common sense.
sentences.zh: 这纯粹是常识。

sentences.en: You don't just go riding around in a car that a thousand police officers and 70,000 people are looking for.
sentences.zh: 你不会随随便便开着一辆有一千名警察和七万人正在搜寻的车到处兜风。

sentences.en: The mysterious reappearance of Zeb's car led to an increase in media attention and tips continued to come in.
sentences.zh: 泽布汽车的神秘重现引发了媒体的更多关注，线索也源源不断地涌来。

sentences.en: Police explored each one, but nothing substantial emerged.
sentences.zh: 警方对每一条线索都进行了调查，但没有出现任何实质性的进展。

sentences.en: Zeb's co-workers at Walmart rallied behind the Quinn family by pinning yellow ribbons to their work uniforms, a symbol of hope for Zeb's safe return.
sentences.zh: 沃尔玛的泽布同事们通过在工作制服上别上黄丝带支持奎因家族，这是泽布安全归来的希望象征。

sentences.en: A poster with the Zeb's picture detailing his last known movements was displayed at the front of the store, urging customers to come
sentences.zh: 一张印有泽布照片并详细说明他最后行踪的海报张贴在商店正门，敦促顾客前来

sentences.en: forward if they had any information that could help with the investigation.
sentences.zh: 提供任何有助于调查的信息。

sentences.en: Walmart's staff even opened a fundraising account to help Denise pay for her independent search efforts and encouraged customers to donate to the fund.
sentences.zh: 沃尔玛员工甚至设立了一个筹款账户，帮助丹尼斯支付自主搜寻的费用，并鼓励顾客向该基金捐款。

sentences.en: Zeb's father, Jerry Quinn, refused to give up hope that his son was still alive.
sentences.zh: 泽布的父亲杰瑞·奎因拒绝放弃他儿子仍然活着的希望。

sentences.en: The two hadn't spent much time together during Zeb's childhood, but they'd recently rekindled their relationship.
sentences.zh: 在泽布的童年时期，两人并没有花太多时间相处，但他们最近重燃了父子情谊。

sentences.en: Jerry was certain Zeb would contact him on his birthday.
sentences.zh: 杰瑞确信泽布会在他生日那天联系他。

sentences.en: Jerry spent the entire day by the phone, but the date passed with no word from Zeb.
sentences.zh: 杰瑞一整天都守在电话旁，但日子一天天过去，没有泽布的一点消息。

sentences.en: The longer Zeb remained missing, the more the rumour mill swung into overdrive.
sentences.zh: 泽布失踪的时间越长，谣言就传得越厉害。

sentences.en: Locals began considering all kinds of outlandish theories, none of which held any merit.
sentences.zh: 当地人开始考虑各种稀奇古怪的理论，但没有一个具有价值。

sentences.en: The private investigator hired by the Quinn family told journalist Brett Forrest for Spin magazine,
sentences.zh: 奎因家族雇佣的私家侦探在接受《Spin》杂志记者布雷特·福雷斯特采访时说道：

sentences.en: I have checked everything I can possibly think of – gangs, witchcraft, drugs, deviant sexual behaviour –
sentences.zh: 我查了我能想到的所有事情——帮派、巫术、毒品、性倒错行为——

sentences.en: and I can't come up with an explanation for the lips on the back of the car.
sentences.zh: 但我还是无法对车背面的嘴唇做出解释。

sentences.en: It took a while before police were able to access the records for Zeb's pager.
sentences.zh: 警方花了很长时间才获取到泽布寻呼机的记录。

sentences.en: Looking through the data from the night he disappeared, it seemed that Jason Owens had been telling the truth.
sentences.zh: 通过查看他失踪当晚的数据，似乎杰森·欧文斯说的是实话。

sentences.en: Zeb had indeed received a page just a few minutes after the two of them left the gas station.
sentences.zh: 就在两人离开加油站几分钟后，泽布确实收到了一条传呼。

sentences.en: The number was traced to the apartment of Ina Rustich, Zeb's paternal aunt.
sentences.zh: 该号码追溯到泽布的姑姑伊娜·鲁斯蒂奇的公寓。

sentences.en: Police went to speak with Ina.
sentences.zh: 警方前去与伊娜交谈。

sentences.en: She vehemently denied having ever paged a Zeb and said she wasn't even home on the night in question.
sentences.zh: 她强烈否认自己曾给泽布发过传呼，并称她在出事的当晚根本不在家。

sentences.en: She'd been eating dinner at her friend Tamara Taylor's house.
sentences.zh: 她一直在朋友塔玛拉·泰勒家里吃晚饭。

sentences.en: The two women worked together at Costa's Kitchen, the restaurant owned by Denise Quinn's boyfriend.
sentences.zh: 这两个女人在丹尼斯·奎因男友拥有的餐厅科斯塔厨房一起工作。

sentences.en: Coincidentally, the police already knew about this dinner.
sentences.zh: 巧合的是，警方已经知道了这顿晚饭。

sentences.en: Tamara Taylor was Misty Taylor's mother.
sentences.zh: 塔玛拉·泰勒是米丝蒂·泰勒的母亲。

sentences.en: It was this dinner that both Misty and her boyfriend Wesley Smith had attended on the night Zeb went missing, thus giving them both airtight alibis.
sentences.zh: 正是这顿晚饭，米丝蒂和她的男友韦斯利·史密斯在泽布失踪的那晚都出席了，从而为两人提供了严密的不在场证明。

sentences.en: The problem was, Ina Rustich lived alone and she said no one else had a key to her apartment.
sentences.zh: 问题是，伊娜·鲁斯蒂奇独居，她说没有其他人有她公寓的钥匙。

sentences.en: So how could Zeb have received a page from her phone?
sentences.zh: 那么泽布怎么会收到来自她电话的传呼呢？

sentences.en: According to Weiner, when she returned home after Tamara's dinner, it seemed that someone had broken into her apartment.
sentences.zh: 据韦纳称，当她在塔玛拉的晚饭后回到家时，似乎有人闯入了她的公寓。

sentences.en: Nothing appeared to be missing, but various items were out of place and the phone had been moved to a different part of the house.
sentences.zh: 没有什么东西丢失，但各种物品错位了，电话也被移到了房子的另一个地方。

sentences.en: Police checked Ina Ustich's phone records and discovered that three minutes after Zeb Quinn received the page from Ina's number, someone called her apartment.
sentences.zh: 警方检查了伊娜·乌斯蒂奇的通话记录，发现泽布·奎因收到来自伊娜号码的传呼三分钟后，有人打了他公寓的电话。

sentences.en: The number was traced to the home of Ina's brother, Jerry Quinn, Zeb's father.
sentences.zh: 该号码追溯到伊娜的兄弟、泽布的父亲杰瑞·奎因的家。

sentences.en: But Jerry strongly denied making the call to Ina's apartment on the night that Zeb disappeared.
sentences.zh: 但杰瑞强烈否认在泽布失踪当晚给伊娜的公寓打过电话。

sentences.en: Like Ina, he claimed he wasn't even home at the time.
sentences.zh: 和伊娜一样，他声称自己当时根本不在家。

sentences.en: Jerry owned a bar in Asheville's Biltmore Village area and he'd been working on the night in question.
sentences.zh: 杰瑞在阿什维尔的比尔特摩村地区拥有一家酒吧，出事当晚他一直在工作。

sentences.en: He told the Asheville Citizen Times,
sentences.zh: 他告诉《阿什维尔公民时报》：

sentences.en: I didn't make no call.
sentences.zh: 我没有打电话。

sentences.en: I don't know who could have done that.
sentences.zh: 我不知道谁会这么做。

sentences.en: Police considered whether Zeb could have made the call to Ina's house from his father's apartment.
sentences.zh: 警方考虑了泽布是否可能是从他父亲的公寓给伊娜家打的电话。

sentences.en: But Jerry lived roughly 7 miles north from the location on Long Shoals Road where Jason Owens claimed Zeb left him to return the urgent page
sentences.zh: 但杰瑞的住处距离杰森·欧文斯声称泽布为了回复紧急传呼而离开他的朗肖尔斯路地点以北大约 7 英里。

sentences.en: The call to Winer's apartment was placed just 3 minutes after Zeb received the page That wouldn't have given him enough time to drive to Jerry's place and make the call
sentences.zh: 打给韦纳公寓的电话是在泽布收到传呼后仅 3 分钟拨打的。这根本没有给他足够的时间开车去杰瑞的住处并打电话

sentences.en: It also wouldn't make sense for him to do so given there were plenty of payphones in the area
sentences.zh: 考虑到该地区有大量的公用电话，他这么做也没有意义

sentences.en: Aina Astitch's phone records also revealed that in the days following Zeb's disappearance, several other calls had been made from her apartment at times when she wasn't at home.
sentences.zh: 爱娜·阿斯蒂奇的通话记录还显示，在泽布失踪后的几天里，她的公寓在不在家的时候还打过几个其他的电话。

sentences.en: On one of those days, she claimed she returned home to find a picture had fallen off the wall and broken.
sentences.zh: 在其中一天，她声称自己回家发现墙上的一幅画掉下来摔碎了。

sentences.en: Aina was subject to a polygraph test, which she passed.
sentences.zh: 爱娜接受了测谎仪测试，并顺利通过了。

sentences.en: Outside of the unexplained page to Zeb, there was nothing to connect her with the case.
sentences.zh: 除了那个无法解释的给泽布的传呼之外，没有什么能把她和这个案子联系起来。

sentences.en: Regardless, some continued to suspect she knew more about Zeb's whereabouts than she was letting on.
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，一些人仍然怀疑她对泽布的下落知道得比透露的要多。

sentences.en: Unfounded rumours swelled that she could have been helping to hide her nephew.
sentences.zh: 毫无根据的谣言甚嚣尘上，称她可能一直在协助藏匿她的侄子。

sentences.en: Jerry Quinn told Spin Magazine that he'd threatened his sister, warning, if I find you're hiding something, I swear to God I will cripple you for life.
sentences.zh: 杰瑞·奎因告诉《Spin》杂志，他曾威胁他的姐姐，警告道：“如果我发现你藏了什么东西，我向上帝发誓，我要让你终身残疾。”

sentences.en: Every time you get up and hobble, you'll think about me.
sentences.zh: 每次你站起来一瘸一拐的时候，你都会想起我。

sentences.en: You're my family, but here's my baby.
sentences.zh: 你是我的家人，但这是我的心肝宝贝。

sentences.en: Ina was distraught by this and swore she didn't know anything.
sentences.zh: 伊娜对此感到痛苦万分，发誓她什么也不知道。

sentences.en: Nevertheless, Jerry told
sentences.zh: 尽管如此，杰瑞告诉

sentences.en: Spin, something makes me feel pretty weird about her.
sentences.zh: 《Spin》杂志，有些事情让我对她感觉很诡异。

sentences.en: Unable to handle the scrutiny, Ina moved interstate.
sentences.zh: 无法承受这种严厉的审查，伊娜搬到了外州。

sentences.en: She told the Asheville Citizen Times she had no idea what happened to Zeb, stating, I could never do anything to harm a hair on that boy's head.
sentences.zh: 她告诉《阿什维尔公民时报》，她不知道泽布发生了什么，并表示：“我永远不会做出任何伤害那个男孩一根毫毛的事。”

sentences.en: I love him.
sentences.zh: 我爱他。

sentences.en: I'm just like everyone else.
sentences.zh: 我和其他人一样。

sentences.en: I want to know what happened.
sentences.zh: 我想知道发生了什么。

sentences.en: By the time Zeb Quinn had been missing for seven months, police had followed up on approximately 150 leads.
sentences.zh: 到泽布·奎因失踪七个月的时候，警方已经跟进了大约 150 条线索。

sentences.en: They'd even taken seriously two separate reports from local women who claimed to have psychic visions in which Zeb was dead and buried.
sentences.zh: 他们甚至严肃对待了当地妇女的两份独立报告，这些妇女声称自己有通灵幻象，在幻象中泽布已经死亡并被埋葬。

sentences.en: One of the women claimed that the murder weapon had been thrown into Lake Julian near Long
sentences.zh: 其中一名女子声称凶器被扔进了朗

sentences.en: Shoals Road and took police out on a fruitless search for it.
sentences.zh: 肖尔斯路附近的朱利安湖，并带着警察进行了一场徒劳的搜寻。

sentences.en: Denise Quinn continued to do all she could to find her son, handing out missing person flyers, speaking to reporters, and searching for his face among crowds.
sentences.zh: 丹尼斯·奎因继续尽其所能寻找她的儿子，分发寻人传单，接受记者采访，并在人群中搜寻他的面孔。

sentences.en: Locals were reminded of Denise's heartache every time they drove by a billboard in town she'd paid for, which read, Zeb, lots of people love you and miss you.
sentences.zh: 每当当地人开车路过她自费在镇上设立的一块广告牌时，都会想起丹尼斯的悲伤，上面写着：“泽布，很多人爱你、想念你。”

sentences.en: Honey, where are you?
sentences.zh: 亲爱的，你在哪？

sentences.en: I miss you so much.
sentences.zh: 我太想你了。

sentences.en: Love, Mum.
sentences.zh: 爱你的妈妈。

sentences.en: With no confirmed sightings and Zeb's bank account and social security number remaining untouched, investigators came to the conclusion
sentences.zh: 由于没有得到证实的目击报告，且泽布的银行账户和社保号一直未被动用，调查人员得出结论

sentences.en: that Zeb had most likely been the victim of a homicide.
sentences.zh: 泽布极有可能成为了一起凶杀案的受害者。

sentences.en: If so, they believed that the killer didn't act alone.
sentences.zh: 如果是这样，他们认为凶手不是单作案。

sentences.en: One police spokesperson said,
sentences.zh: 一位警方发言人表示：

sentences.en: Just the mechanics of killing someone and disposing of the body would lead us to believe more than one person had to be involved.
sentences.zh: 仅就杀人及处理尸体的作案手法而言，就会让我们相信这必定涉及多人。

sentences.en: While they remained open to the possibility that Zeb could still be alive, they'd uncovered no reason to suggest that he left voluntarily.
sentences.zh: 虽然他们仍然对泽布可能还活着抱有开放态度，但他们没有发现任何迹象表明他是自愿离开的。

sentences.en: The Quinn family considered whether Zeb could have gotten into a scuffle with someone that had gotten out of hand.
sentences.zh: 奎因一家考虑过泽布是否与某人发生过冲突并且失控了。

sentences.en: He could be naive and it was possible that he was placed in a difficult situation that he didn't know how to get out of.
sentences.zh: 他可能很天真，也可能陷入了一种他不知道该如何摆脱的困境。

sentences.en: Denise Quinn told the Asheville Citizen Times,
sentences.zh: 丹尼斯·奎因告诉《阿什维尔公民时报》：

sentences.en: I'm angry at the people here who know something but who won't say anything.
sentences.zh: 我很生这里那些知道内情却闭口不言的人的气。

sentences.en: I just need to know whether he's dead or alive.
sentences.zh: 我只想知道他是死是活。

sentences.en: I just need to know whether I should grieve or wish him well.
sentences.zh: 我只想知道我该悲伤还是该祝他一切都好。

sentences.en: If someone would just drop us an anonymous note or tell us where he's buried, I just want to be able to find some peace.
sentences.zh: 如果有人能给我们留个匿名便条，或者告诉我们他埋在哪里，我只想能够获得一些平静。

sentences.en: One detective told the Hickory Daily Record,
sentences.zh: 一位警探告诉《希科里每日记录报》：

sentences.en: It's very frustrating.
sentences.zh: 这太令人沮丧了。

sentences.en: You feel for the parents and wish you could give them an answer.
sentences.zh: 你为父母感到难过，希望你能给他们一个答案。

sentences.en: Sometimes you get a case that there just aren't any answers too.
sentences.zh: 有时你会遇到一个根本没有任何答案的案件。

sentences.en: The one-year anniversary of Zeb's disappearance came and went, with the $15,000 reward for information going unclaimed.
sentences.zh: 泽布失踪一周年转瞬即逝，1.5万美元的线索悬赏金无人认领。

sentences.en: Zeb had missed Christmas, his favourite holiday, and the birth of his second niece, further adding to the belief that he was no longer alive.
sentences.zh: 泽布错过了圣诞节（他最喜欢的节日）以及第二个侄女的出生，这进一步加深了人们认为他已经不在人世的信念。

sentences.en: Denise Quinn had since gotten engaged to her boyfriend, Costa, and it broke her heart that
sentences.zh: 此后，丹尼斯·奎因与男友科斯塔订婚了，而这让她心碎的是

sentences.en: Zeb wouldn't be there to walk her down the aisle.
sentences.zh: 泽布无法陪伴她走过红毯。

sentences.en: Denise had no doubt that someone in town knew something they refused to disclose.
sentences.zh: 丹尼斯毫不怀疑镇上有人知道他们拒绝透露的内情。

sentences.en: She told the Asheville Citizen Times,
sentences.zh: 她告诉《阿什维尔公民时报》：

sentences.en: somebody had his car and if nothing else, they know where they got it.
sentences.zh: 有人拿着他的车，退一步说，他们知道车是从哪儿弄来的。

sentences.en: Even if they found it abandoned, they know where it was and it could be the one thing that would help.
sentences.zh: 即使他们发现车是被遗弃的，他们也知道车在哪儿，这可能是能提供帮助的关键线索。

sentences.en: Zeb's father, Jerry, blamed police incompetence for the lack of progress in his son's case
sentences.zh: 泽布的父亲杰里将儿子案件进展停滞归咎于警方的无能。

sentences.en: The Asheville Police Department was only small and officers lacked the experience and resources required for a case of this magnitude
sentences.zh: 阿什维尔警察局规模很小，警官们缺乏这种规模案件所需的经验和资源。

sentences.en: Jerry was convinced that Misty Taylor's boyfriend, Wesley Smith had something to do with Zeb's disappearance
sentences.zh: 杰里坚信米斯蒂·泰勒的男友韦斯利·史密斯与泽布的失踪有关。

sentences.en: While local suspicion remained against Misty and Wesley many believed there was a more obvious culprit, Jason Owens.
sentences.zh: 虽然当地人依然对米斯蒂和韦斯利抱有怀疑，但许多人认为有一个更明显的罪魁祸首——杰森·欧文斯。

sentences.en: Not only was he the last person seen with Zeb, the fact that he'd called Walmart pretending to be Zeb was a detail many couldn't get paSt.
sentences.zh: 他不仅是最后一个被看到和泽布在一起的人，而且他曾打电话给沃尔玛并假冒泽布，这个细节让许多人无法释怀。

sentences.en: Jason continued to not cooperate with the police and spoke publicly about the case only once, telling Spin Magazine, I was totally in the wrong place at the wrong time.
sentences.zh: 杰森继续不配合警方调查，并且只公开谈论过一次该案，他对《Spin》杂志说：“我完全是在错误的时间出现在了错误的地点。”

sentences.en: If just one thing different would have happened, I wouldn't be in the middle of it.
sentences.zh: 只要有一件事发生得不同，我就不会卷入其中了。

sentences.en: But I'm in the middle of it, stuck here until something's figured out.
sentences.zh: 但我现在卷进来了，被困在这里，直到事情水落石出。

sentences.en: Locals weren't the only ones suspicious of Jason Owens.
sentences.zh: 当地人并不是唯一怀疑杰森·欧文斯的人。

sentences.en: Police also couldn't shake the feeling that he was involved in Zeb's disappearance in some way.
sentences.zh: 警方也无法摆脱这样一种感觉：他以某种方式参与了泽布的失踪。

sentences.en: During the course of their investigation, intriguing information had emerged.
sentences.zh: 在调查过程中，一些耐人寻味的信息浮出水面。

sentences.en: As detailed in the documentary A Good Kid, police records revealed that on the morning Zeb went missing, Jason Owen's mother had called the county sheriff's department.
sentences.zh: 正如纪录片《好孩子》中所详细描述的那样，警方记录显示，在泽布失踪的那天早上，杰森·欧文斯的母亲给县警长办公室打了电话。

sentences.en: The call, placed at
sentences.zh: 这通电话打于

sentences.en: 7am, was to report that her own son was missing.
sentences.zh: 早上7点，目的是报告她自己的儿子失踪了。

sentences.en: She'd become worried that Jason had failed to return home after going out the night before.
sentences.zh: 她开始担心杰森前一天晚上出门后没有回家。

sentences.en: With all this information combined, police felt they had enough evidence to establish probable cause.
sentences.zh: 结合所有这些信息，警方觉得他们有足够的证据来确定合理根据。

sentences.en: In February 2001, 13 months after Zeb's disappearance, a judge issued a warrant for officers to draw hair, blood and saliva samples from Jason Owens.
sentences.zh: 2001年2月，在泽布失踪13个月后，一名法官签发了一份搜查令，授权警官提取杰森·欧文斯的毛发、血液和唾液样本。

sentences.en: While they didn't necessarily have any samples to compare them against, at least they now had them on file.
sentences.zh: 虽然他们不一定有任何样本来与之对比，但至少他们现在将其存档了。

sentences.en: But by late October 2002, almost three years had passed.
sentences.zh: 但到了2002年10月下旬，将近三年过去了。

sentences.en: There hadn't been a single breakthrough in the Zeb Quinn case.
sentences.zh: 泽布·奎因案没有取得任何突破。

sentences.en: In the early hours of Tuesday, October 29,
sentences.zh: 在10月29日星期二的清晨，

sentences.en: Asheville Police Officer Diana Loveland was driving along Interstate 240 on her way back to the station when she saw a pickup truck hurtling down the highway.
sentences.zh: 阿什维尔警察局警官黛安·洛夫兰在返回警局的途中驾驶巡逻车沿240号州际公路行驶，这时她看到一辆皮卡车在高速公路上疾驰。

sentences.en: Suspecting the driver was intoxicated,
sentences.zh: 怀疑司机酒驾，

sentences.en: Officer Loveland flashed her lights and signalled for them to pull over.
sentences.zh: 洛夫兰警官闪烁警灯并示意他们靠边停车。

sentences.en: Instead, the driver picked up speed.
sentences.zh: 然而，司机反而加快了速度。

sentences.en: With Officer Loveland giving chase and calling for backup, the pickup truck eventually exited onto Long Shoals Road.
sentences.zh: 在洛夫兰警官一路追赶并呼叫支援的情况下，这辆皮卡最终驶向了长浅滩路的出口。

sentences.en: Maintaining speeds of over 80 miles per hour, the driver suddenly raised a gun and began shooting out the window.
sentences.zh: 在保持每小时80英里以上车速的同时，司机突然举起枪，开始朝窗外射击。

sentences.en: Then, after speeding through an intersection, the vehicle hit a mailbox and flipped.
sentences.zh: 随后，在高速冲过一个十字路口后，车辆撞上了一个邮箱并翻了车。

sentences.en: The driver was none other than 24-year-old Jason Owens.
sentences.zh: 司机不是别人，正是24岁的杰森·欧文斯。

sentences.en: Jason was treated in hospital for several days before being arrested on nine charges related to the high-speed chase,
sentences.zh: 杰森在医院接受了几天的治疗，随后因与这起高速追捕相关的九项罪名被捕，

sentences.en: including a looting arrest and assault on a law enforcement officer with a firearm.
sentences.zh: 其中包括抢劫罪以及持枪袭警。

sentences.en: He ultimately pleaded guilty and was sentenced to eight months in prison.
sentences.zh: 他最终承认了指控，并被判处八个月监禁。

sentences.en: Police refused to say whether Jason Owens was questioned further about Zeb Quinn as part of the car chase investigation, but a healthcare professional recommended he seek treatment
sentences.zh: 警方拒绝透露在追车案调查期间是否就泽布·奎因一案对杰森·欧文斯进行了进一步讯问，但一位医疗专业人士建议他寻求治疗

sentences.en: for alcohol abuse.
sentences.zh: 以戒除酗酒问题。

sentences.en: Two months later, in December 2002, cadets from the Reserve Officers Training
sentences.zh: 两个月后，即2002年12月，预备役军官训练

sentences.en: Corps unit that Zeb had been part of surprised his family with a memorial service in Zeb's honour.
sentences.zh: 营（泽布曾是其中一员）的学员们为泽布举办了一场纪念仪式，以此给他的家人一个惊喜。

sentences.en: With the three-year anniversary of his disappearance approaching, they wanted Zeb's loved ones to know that his case hadn't been forgotten.
sentences.zh: 随着他失踪三周年的临近，他们希望泽布的至亲知道，他的案子并没有被遗忘。

sentences.en: Denise held back tears as she was presented with a photo of her son in a memory book the cadets had put together, the ambiguous loss no easier to live with despite the years
sentences.zh: 当学员们整理的纪念册中一张她儿子的照片呈现在眼前时，丹尼斯强忍着泪水，尽管时光流逝，

sentences.en: that had passed.
sentences.zh: 这种含糊不清的失落感并没有变得更容易承受。

sentences.en: As time wore on, officers spoke to criminal profilers, searched various areas with cadets
sentences.zh: 随着时间推移，警官们与犯罪侧写师交谈，与学员和搜救

sentences.en: David dogs and followed up on all reported sightings to no impact.
sentences.zh: 警犬一起搜查了各个区域，并跟进所有报告的目击线索，但都无济于事。

sentences.en: 2007 marked the seventh year of the investigation.
sentences.zh: 2007年是调查工作的第七个年头。

sentences.en: That year, in April, new evidence emerged that allowed police to get a search warrant for Jason Owens' property.
sentences.zh: 那年4月，新证据浮出水面，使警方得以获得搜查杰森·欧文斯财产的搜查令。

sentences.en: He lived with his wife on Owens Cove Road, a remote dead-end stretch in Leicester, roughly 14 miles from downtown Asheville.
sentences.zh: 他和妻子住在莱斯特的欧文斯湾路，这是一条偏僻的死胡同，距离阿什维尔市中心大约14英里。

sentences.en: Over the years, Jason continued to rack up criminal convictions, receiving charges for distributing prescription drugs and being in possession of stolen goods.
sentences.zh: 多年来，杰森不断积累刑事定罪，因分发处方药和持有赃物而受到指控。

sentences.en: Police wouldn't tell the media what the new evidence was, simply commenting,
sentences.zh: 警方没有向媒体透露新证据是什么，只是评论道：

sentences.en: We hope we can further the investigation.
sentences.zh: 我们希望能够进一步推进调查。

sentences.en: We are leaving no stone unturned.
sentences.zh: 我们不会放过任何线索。

sentences.en: Officers also sought help from NecroSearch, a non-profit organisation dedicated to helping law enforcement uncover clandestine graves and other evidence
sentences.zh: 警官们还向NecroSearch寻求帮助，这是一个致力于帮助执法部门发现秘密坟墓和其他证据的非营利组织。

sentences.en: They used aerial photography and ground-penetrating radar to search Jason's expansive wooded property
sentences.zh: 他们使用航空摄影和探地雷达搜查了杰森占地广阔的林木土地。

sentences.en: Nothing of interest was found
sentences.zh: 没有发现任何有价值的东西。

sentences.en: In the two years that followed, police started reinvestigating Zeb's disappearance from scratch
sentences.zh: 在接下来的两年里，警方开始从头重新调查泽布的失踪案。

sentences.en: They obtained DNA from Misty Taylor and Wesley Smith, who had collectively been questioned nine times since January 2000.
sentences.zh: 他们获取了米斯蒂·泰勒和韦斯利·史密斯的DNA，自2000年1月以来，这两人总共被讯问过九次。

sentences.en: Police made it clear that neither Misty nor Wesley were being treated as suspects, and that collection of their DNA was simply part of their comprehensive efforts.
sentences.zh: 警方明确表示，米斯蒂和韦斯利均未被视为嫌疑人，收集他们的DNA只是他们全面工作的一部分。

sentences.en: No new discoveries emerged, and by the 10-year anniversary of Zeb's disappearance in 2010, his case remained one of 23 on the Asheville Police Department's cold case liSt.
sentences.zh: 没有出现新的发现，到2010年泽布失踪十周年之际，他的案子仍然是阿什维尔警察局23起积案之一。

sentences.en: Officers once again appealed for information in the hopes that loyalties might have changed over time.
sentences.zh: 警方再次呼吁提供线索，希望随着时间的推移，人们的忠诚度可能会发生变化。

sentences.en: A tearful Denise Quinn told the Asheville Citizen Times,
sentences.zh: 泪流满面的丹尼斯·奎因告诉《阿什维尔公民时报》：

sentences.en: Basically, all of us are, to a point, stuck on that day when Zeb disappeared.
sentences.zh: 基本上，我们所有人都在某种程度上被困在了泽布失踪的那一天。

sentences.en: With no sense of what happened to him or where his remains were, Denise said,
sentences.zh: 由于对他的遭遇或遗体所在毫无头绪，丹尼斯说：

sentences.en: Just not having anything is torture.
sentences.zh: 什么都不知道简直就是折磨。

sentences.en: It doesn't go away.
sentences.zh: 这种感觉挥之不去。

sentences.en: She wrote an open letter to the people of Asheville, saying,
sentences.zh: 她写了一封给阿什维尔人民的公开信，说道：

sentences.en: For now, until someone realises it has been way too long and calls in some information to help us,
sentences.zh: 目前，在有人意识到时间已经太久并打来线索电话帮助我们之前，

sentences.en: all we can do is wait, day by day, to hear that the police have finally gotten the break they need to answer our prayers.
sentences.zh: 我们所能做的就是日复一日地等待，听到警方终于取得了他们需要的突破来回答我们的祈祷。

sentences.en: By the start of 2015, 15 years had passed with no answers for Zeb's loved ones,
sentences.zh: 到2015年头，15年过去了，泽布的至亲依然没有得到任何答案，

sentences.en: despite the case receiving national coverage when it was featured on an episode of Investigation Discoveries
sentences.zh: 尽管该案在被时代华纳旗下探索频道（Investigation Discovery）的

sentences.en: Disappeared program.
sentences.zh: 《失踪》节目专题报道时曾获得全国范围的关注。

sentences.en: Zeb's disappearance had become somewhat of an urban legend.
sentences.zh: 泽布的失踪已经变成了一种某种程度上的都市传说。

sentences.en: It continued to be talked about from time to time and locals held on to their theories, but it had mostly faded from the public consciousness.
sentences.zh: 人们时不时地继续谈论它，当地人也坚持着他们的理论，但它已经在很大程度上淡出了公众的意识。

sentences.en: Police Sergeant Chuck Sams was one of few reminded of the case every day.
sentences.zh: 警长警佐查克·萨姆斯是少数每天都会想起这个案子的人之一。

sentences.en: He'd been on duty on the day Zeb's car was found.
sentences.zh: 泽布的车被发现的那天他在值班。

sentences.en: Chuck adopted the puppy found inside, giving her the name Katie.
sentences.zh: 查克收养了车里发现的小狗，给她取名叫凯蒂。

sentences.en: Katie had gone on to live a long and happy life, but she was a living reminder of the ongoing mystery.
sentences.zh: 凯蒂后来过上了漫长而幸福的生活，但她却是这桩仍在持续的谜团的一个活生生的提醒。

sentences.en: For engaged couple Christy Schoen and JT Codd, the mountainous area surrounding Asheville, North Carolina, seemed like the perfect place to settle down.
sentences.zh: 对于已订婚的情侣克里斯蒂·舍恩和JT·科德来说，北卡罗来纳州阿什维尔周边的山区似乎是安定下来的完美地方。

sentences.en: Having both spent many years working long hours in the entertainment industry, they were excited to slow down and start a family
sentences.zh: 两人都在娱乐行业长期超负荷工作多年，他们很高兴能放慢节奏并组建家庭。

sentences.en: The two had met behind the scenes on a television show
sentences.zh: 两人是在一档电视节目的幕后相识的。

sentences.en: JT, whose real name was Joseph, worked as a key grip responsible for all non-electrical support gear on set
sentences.zh: JT（真名叫约瑟夫）是一名核心场务，负责片场所有非电气支撑设备。

sentences.en: christie worked as a professional caterer leaning into skills she'd developed having grown up in
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂是一名专业餐饮服务商，她依靠在

sentences.en: louisiana cooking cajun cuisine with her father she was also an aspiring actor who did occasional
sentences.zh: 路易斯安那州长大期间与父亲一起烹饪卡真美食所培养的技能，她还是一位有抱负的演员，偶尔

sentences.en: work as a stunt double in 2012 christie combined to these two passions by appearing as a contestant
sentences.zh: 担任特技替身。2012年，克里斯蒂将这两种热情结合起来，作为选手参加了美食频道的真人秀节目

sentences.en: on the reality television show food network star although she was eliminated in the first round her passion for food only grew stronger.
sentences.zh: 《美食网明星》。虽然她在第一轮就被淘汰了，但她对食物的热情却有增无减。

sentences.en: When Christy and JT decided to leave Los Angeles for North Carolina and purchase a 36-acre property on Hooker's Gap Road in Leicester, they had a shared vision.
sentences.zh: 当克里斯蒂和JT决定离开洛杉矶前往北卡罗来纳州，并在莱斯特的胡克加普路购买了一处占地36英亩的房产时，他们有着共同的愿景。

sentences.en: They'd used the property to grow their own food, which they'd then used to start a farm-to-table cafe.
sentences.zh: 他们利用这处房产种植自己的食物，然后用这些食物开办了一家从农场到餐桌的咖啡馆。

sentences.en: With a variety of established fruit trees on the land already, the property suited them well.
sentences.zh: 由于土地上已经有各种成熟的果树，这处房产非常适合他们。

sentences.en: A close friend of JT's told People magazine that while the property wasn't exactly remarkable, quote, JT was making it remarkable because that's what he did with everything.
sentences.zh: JT的一位密友告诉《人物》杂志，虽然这处房产算不上引人注目，但引述他的话说：“JT正在让它变得引人注目，因为他对每件事都是这么做的。”

sentences.en: JT and Christy quickly found their place in their new community and got married at a community centre outside of Asheville.
sentences.zh: JT和克里斯蒂迅速在新社区找到了自己的位置，并在阿什维尔郊外的一个社区中心举行了婚礼。

sentences.en: A few months later, they shared the news with their loved ones that Christy was pregnant.
sentences.zh: 几个月后，他们与至亲分享了克里斯蒂怀孕的好消息。

sentences.en: When they found out they were having a girl, they decided on the name Skylar.
sentences.zh: 当他们得知怀的是个女孩时，他们决定起名叫斯凯勒。

sentences.en: For the newlyweds, everything was falling into place.
sentences.zh: 对这对新婚夫妇来说，一切都在步入正轨。

sentences.en: Then, on Sunday March 15, 2015, one of their neighbours, Cecilia Owens, received a phone call.
sentences.zh: 然后，在2015年3月15日星期日，他们的邻居之一塞西莉亚·欧文斯接到了一个电话。

sentences.en: It was Christy's father calling from his home in Mississippi.
sentences.zh: 那是克里斯蒂的父亲从他在密西西比州的家中打来的。

sentences.en: He'd become concerned after Christy, who was five months pregnant, had failed to show up for a planned visit without any explanation.
sentences.zh: 他变得焦虑不安，因为怀孕五个月的克里斯蒂没有毫无解释地出现在计划中的探访中。

sentences.en: He hadn't been able to get in touch with her since.
sentences.zh: 自那以后他就一直联系不上她。

sentences.en: Cecilia Owens had house-sat for the couple in the past and had a key to their home.
sentences.zh: 塞西莉亚·欧文斯过去曾为这对夫妇看房，并拥有他们家的钥匙。

sentences.en: Christy's father asked Cecilia if she could go over and check on them.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂的父亲问塞西莉亚能否过去看看他们。

sentences.en: As soon as Cecilia arrived on the property, she could tell something was wrong.
sentences.zh: 塞西莉亚一到达这处房产，就看出有些不对劲。

sentences.en: The couple's cars were parked in the driveway, but when she knocked on the door, nobody answered.
sentences.zh: 这对夫妇的车停在车道上，但当她敲门时，无人应答。

sentences.en: Cecilia let herself in.
sentences.zh: 塞西莉亚自己开门走了进去。

sentences.en: Christy and JT's two pet dogs were inside, but it was clear they hadn't been tended to in a while.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂和JT的两只宠物狗在屋里，但很明显它们有一段时间没被照料了。

sentences.en: Christy typically kept her house in immaculate condition, but the place now stunk.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂通常把房子收拾得一尘不染，但现在这里臭气熏天。

sentences.en: The dogs had defecated and urinated throughout.
sentences.zh: 狗到处拉屎撒尿。

sentences.en: out.
sentences.zh: 到处都是。

sentences.en: Cecilia knew Christy would never leave her dogs unattended, as she treated them like her babies.
sentences.zh: 塞西莉亚知道克里斯蒂绝不会把狗单独留下不管，因为她把它们当成自己的宝贝一样对待。

sentences.en: Christy's father called the county sheriff's department and deputies arrived at the couple's home to conduct a welfare check.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂的父亲打电话给县警长办公室，副警长们来到这对夫妇的家中进行福利查访。

sentences.en: A cursory search of the home turned up no sign of the couple, but there was evidence of a break-in.
sentences.zh: 对房屋的粗略搜查没有发现这对夫妇的踪迹，但有入室盗窃的迹象。

sentences.en: Several items appeared to be missing, but Christy and JT's wallets were present, sparking immediate concerns for their well-being.
sentences.zh: 几件物品似乎不见了，但克里斯蒂和JT的钱包还在，这立即引发了对他们安危的担忧。

sentences.en: More officers arrived to assist with the search, but with the 36-acre property encompassing valleys and mountainous woodland, searching it all would be no easy task.
sentences.zh: 更多警官赶来协助搜查，但由于这处占地36英亩的房产包含山谷和山区林地，搜查全部区域绝非易事。

sentences.en: Word quickly spread that 45-year-old JT and 38-year-old Christy were missing, and locals were advised to contact the police with any information pertaining to their whereabouts.
sentences.zh: 45岁的JT和38岁的克里斯蒂失踪的消息迅速传开，当地人被告知如有任何关于他们下落的信息请联系警方。

sentences.en: At 8.30pm, a call came through from a member of the public who wanted to report something suspicious.
sentences.zh: 晚上8点30分，一个热心市民打来电话，想要举报一些可疑情况。

sentences.en: On a dead-end street roughly six miles from the Shoen Cobb home, they'd seen a man throwing some items into a private residential dumpster.
sentences.zh: 在距离舍恩-科德住宅大约六英里的一条死胡同里，他们看到一个男人把一些东西扔进一个私人住宅垃圾箱里。

sentences.en: Investigators went to the address and retrieved several garbage bags from the dumpster.
sentences.zh: 调查人员前往该地址，从垃圾箱中取回了几个垃圾袋。

sentences.en: Inside were numerous items, including a bedspread, handgun, ammunition, and jewellery.
sentences.zh: 里面有许多物品，包括床罩、手枪、弹药和珠宝。

sentences.en: There was little doubt as to who they belonged to.
sentences.zh: 这些东西属于谁，几乎毫无疑问。

sentences.en: Not only were these items missing from the Schoenkob household, among the belongings was
sentences.zh: 这些物品不仅是从舍恩-科德家中失窃的，而且在这些属于物品中还有

sentences.en: Christy's ID.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂的身份证。

sentences.en: But the biggest breakthrough was that the witness recognised the man they saw dumping the iteMs. 36-year-old Robert Jason Owens.
sentences.zh: 但最大的突破是，目击者认出了他们看到倾倒物品的那个男人——36岁的罗伯特·杰森·欧文斯。

sentences.en: Case File will be back shortly.
sentences.zh: 档案节目稍后回来。

sentences.en: Thank you for supporting us by listening to this episode's sponsors.
sentences.zh: 感谢您通过收听本期节目的赞助商来支持我们。

sentences.en: Thank you for listening to this episode's ads.
sentences.zh: 感谢您收听本期节目的广告。

sentences.en: By supporting our sponsors, you support Case File to continue to deliver quality content.
sentences.zh: 通过支持我们的赞助商，您就是在支持档案节目继续提供优质内容。

sentences.en: At 1.30am on Monday, March 16, 2015, police arrived at Jason Owens' home on
sentences.zh: 2015年3月16日星期一凌晨1点30分，警方抵达位于

sentences.en: Owens Cove Road.
sentences.zh: 欧文斯湾路的杰森·欧文斯家中。

sentences.en: He lived just one mile from Christie and JT's property and was known to the couple.
sentences.zh: 他住在距离克里斯蒂和JT房产仅一英里远的地方，并且这对夫妇认识他。

sentences.en: Jason had been one of the first people JT and Christie had met when they moved to the area.
sentences.zh: 杰森是JT和克里斯蒂搬到该地区后遇到最早的人之一。

sentences.en: Unemployed at the time, he'd accepted JT's offer to help out with some handyman jobs on their property.
sentences.zh: 当时失业的他接受了JT的提议，帮忙在他们的房产上做一些杂务零工。

sentences.en: Extending a hand to those in need was part of JT's nature.
sentences.zh: 向有需要的人伸出援手是JT天性的一部分。

sentences.en: As a close friend of his told People magazine.
sentences.zh: 正如他的密友告诉《人物》杂志的那样。

sentences.en: JT was an advocate for every underdog.
sentences.zh: JT是每一个失势者的拥护者。

sentences.en: He really took everybody under his wing who other people weren't willing to give a second look to.
sentences.zh: 他真的把所有那些别人不愿多看一眼的人都庇护在自己的羽翼之下。

sentences.en: Jason Owens got to work clearing trees, building a wellhouse and other such tasks.
sentences.zh: 杰森·欧文斯开始干活，清理树木、建造水井房以及做诸如此类的工作。

sentences.en: The ever-trusting JT eventually gave him a key to their storage shed and loaned him $7,000 so he could start his own contracting business.
sentences.zh: 一贯信任他人的JT最终给了他储藏棚的钥匙，并借给他7,000美元以便他能创办自己的承包业务。

sentences.en: While his generosity had been admired in Los Angeles, it was exploited in North Carolina.
sentences.zh: 虽然他在洛杉矶时因慷慨而备受赞赏，但在北卡罗来纳州，这份善良却遭到了利用。

sentences.en: A friend of the couple told People magazine that JT's willingness to help those down on their luck led to people showing up on their doorstep asking for work or money.
sentences.zh: 这对夫妇的一位朋友告诉《人物》杂志，杰特愿意帮助那些运气不佳的人，导致人们经常找上门来寻求工作或金钱。

sentences.en: He described JT as the ATM of the mountains, a reputation that had started to worry Christy.
sentences.zh: 他将杰特形容为“大山里的提款机”，这个名声开始让克里斯蒂感到担忧。

sentences.en: The police placed Jason Owens under arrest for theft and took him to the station for questioning.
sentences.zh: 警方以盗窃罪将杰森·欧文斯逮捕，并把他带到警察局进行审讯。

sentences.en: As reported in the documentary A Good Kid, they had intentionally transported the dumpster to the station and left it in full view for Jason to see upon arrival.
sentences.zh: 正如纪录片《好孩子》中所报道的那样，他们故意把垃圾箱运到警察局，放在显眼的位置，好让杰森一到就能看见。

sentences.en: When he laid eyes on it, his physical reaction indicated he knew that the jig was up.
sentences.zh: 当他看到那个垃圾箱时，他的身体反应表明他知道自己彻底完蛋了。

sentences.en: Jason Owens immediately began talking.
sentences.zh: 杰森·欧文斯立刻开始交代。

sentences.en: He told the interviewing detectives that he'd arrived at the
sentences.zh: 他告诉负责审讯的侦探，自己在

sentences.en: Shawan Cod household on Thursday March 12 to help them move JT's vehicle after it had become stuck in a nearby creek.
sentences.zh: 3月12日星期四来到了肖恩·科德的家，当时杰特的车陷在附近的溪流里，他是去帮忙移动车辆的。

sentences.en: Jason claimed that he got behind the wheel of the Dodge Ram truck and accidentally slammed his foot onto the accelerator.
sentences.zh: 杰森声称，他坐上了那辆道奇拉姆卡车的驾驶座，却不小心一脚踩到了油门上。

sentences.en: The vehicle sped forward, hitting both JT and
sentences.zh: 车子猛地向前冲去，撞上了杰特以及

sentences.en: Christy who was standing in front of it.
sentences.zh: 正站在车前方的克里斯蒂。

sentences.en: According to Jason, he carried the badly injured Christy into the house and placed her in the living room.
sentences.zh: 据杰森供述，他把身受重伤的克里斯蒂抱进屋里，放在了客厅的地板上。

sentences.en: He tried to administer first aid, but it was no use and she soon passed away.
sentences.zh: 他试图对她实施急救，但无济于事，不久后她便离世了。

sentences.en: He then went back outside, only to find that JT was already dead.
sentences.zh: 随后他回到屋外，却发现杰特已经断了气。

sentences.en: Given that Jason was driving on a suspended license and was taking medication that left him heavily impaired, he said he panicked at the prospect of facing more jail time.
sentences.zh: 鉴于杰森当时处于驾照吊销期间，且服用的药物让他的意识严重受损，他说一想到自己可能面临更长时间的牢狱之灾，就陷入了恐慌。

sentences.en: He took JT's body back to his property, where he burned it in a wood stove.
sentences.zh: 他把杰特的尸体带回了自己的住处，在一个燃木火炉里将其焚烧。

sentences.en: The next day, he returned to the couple's home and dismembered Christy's body in the shower.
sentences.zh: 第二天，他回到这对夫妇的家中，在浴室里分尸了克里斯蒂的遗体。

sentences.en: He then used garbage bags to transport the pieces back to his place and burned those too.
sentences.zh: 接着，他用垃圾袋把尸块运回自己的住处，并把它们也烧毁了。

sentences.en: Jason claimed he tried to cover the accident up as a robbery gone wrong.
sentences.zh: 杰森声称，他试图把这起事故伪装成一起搞砸了的抢劫案。

sentences.en: He stole some of the couple's belongings and sold them at local flea markets and porn stores, using the money to take his wife out for dinner.
sentences.zh: 他偷走了这对夫妇的一些财物，并在当地的跳蚤市场和成人用品店变卖，用这些钱带妻子去吃晚餐。

sentences.en: Jason also admitted to using Christy's cell phone to send text messages to some of her friends to make it look like she was still alive.
sentences.zh: 杰森还承认，他利用克里斯蒂的手机给她的一些朋友发短信，制造她还活着的假象。

sentences.en: The friends who received these messages had been immediately suspicious, as the texts didn't sound like Christy at all.
sentences.zh: 收到这些短信的朋友们立刻产生了怀疑，因为这些短信的语气一点也不像克里斯蒂。

sentences.en: Jason Owens reiterated that he didn't mean to hurt JT or Christy, insisting to the detectives.
sentences.zh: 杰森·欧文斯向侦探坚称，他不是故意要伤害杰特或克里斯蒂的。

sentences.en: I'm not a bad guy.
sentences.zh: “我不是坏人。”

sentences.en: They were two of my best friends.
sentences.zh: “他们是我最好的两个朋友。”

sentences.en: They were.
sentences.zh: “真的是这样。”

sentences.en: I loved them because they loved me.
sentences.zh: “我爱他们，因为他们也爱我。”

sentences.en: JT and Christy didn't have friends, they had family.
sentences.zh: “杰特和克里斯蒂没有朋友，他们有的是家人。”

sentences.en: And just like that, I was part of their family.
sentences.zh: “就这样，我也成了他们家庭的一员。”

sentences.en: It was true that the couple had treated Jason with nothing but kindness.
sentences.zh: 事实的确如此，这对夫妇对杰森关怀备至，没有一丝苛待。

sentences.en: He'd even attended their wedding, where he stood out to the other guests like a sore thumb.
sentences.zh: 他甚至参加了他们的婚礼，在其他宾客中显得格外突兀。

sentences.en: One guest later told People magazine,
sentences.zh: 一位宾客后来告诉《人物》杂志：

sentences.en: There was a gut feeling when I looked at this guy and I avoided him.
sentences.zh: “当我看着这个家伙时，心里有一种直觉，所以我避开了他。”

sentences.en: This was one person I definitely did not want to meet.
sentences.zh: “这个人绝对是我不想结识的。”

sentences.en: A search of Jason Owen's property turned up enough evidence for police to charge him with two counts of first-degree murder and one count of murder of an unborn child.
sentences.zh: 对杰森·欧文斯住所的搜查搜出了足够的证据，足以指控他两项一级谋杀罪以及一项谋杀未出生胎儿罪。

sentences.en: If convicted, he faced the death penalty.
sentences.zh: 如果罪名成立，他将面临死刑。

sentences.en: Jason was denied bail as the investigation continued.
sentences.zh: 随着调查的继续，杰森被拒绝保释。

sentences.en: Then, in the early morning hours of Friday March 20, four days after Jason Owens was taken into custody, panicked calls started coming through to 911.
sentences.zh: 随后，在3月20日星期五的清晨，也就是杰森·欧文斯被拘留四天后，911报警中心接到了大量恐慌的求助电话。

sentences.en: One caller told the dispatcher to send fire and law enforcement to Owens Cove Road immediately, exclaiming, somebody is setting fires to everything up here on this mountain.
sentences.zh: 一名报警人告诉调度员，立刻派消防员和执法人员前往欧文斯湾路，大喊着“有人把这山上所有东西都点着了”。

sentences.en: Hurry.
sentences.zh: “快点。”

sentences.en: First responders arrived at Jason Owens' property to find a mobile home that sat roughly 50 yards from his primary place of residence up in flames.
sentences.zh: 急救人员赶到杰森·欧文斯的住所时，发现距离他主要住所大约50码远的一辆移动房屋正陷入火海中。

sentences.en: By the time the blaze was extinguished, the entire trailer had been burned to the ground.
sentences.zh: 大火被扑灭时，整辆拖车已经被烧成了平地。

sentences.en: Arson investigators confirmed that the fire was suspicious, but they wouldn't say what had caused it.
sentences.zh: 纵火调查人员证实这场火灾可疑，但他们没有说明起火原因。

sentences.en: Investigators on the Schoen-Cod case declined to confirm whether the wood oven stove Jason used to cremate his victim's remains had been located inside the mobile home.
sentences.zh: 肖恩-科德案的调查人员拒绝证实杰森用来火化受害者遗体的燃木火炉是否位于该移动房屋内。

sentences.en: Jason Owens was behind bars at the time of the blaze which raised the question who started the fire and why?
sentences.zh: 火灾发生时，杰森·欧文斯正在狱中，这不禁让人产生疑问：是谁放的火？为什么要放火？

sentences.en: Theories began to circulate that Jason could have had an accomplice within his family who was trying to destroy evidence.
sentences.zh: 各种猜测开始流传，认为杰森可能在家族里有同伙，试图以此毁灭证据。

sentences.en: But there was a more pressing question on everyone's lips.
sentences.zh: 但人们口中谈论的是一个更加迫切的问题。

sentences.en: With the Jason Owens now charged with murder, what did this mean for the Zeb Quinn investigation.
sentences.zh: 既然杰森·欧文斯现在被控谋杀，这对于泽布·奎因的调查意味着什么？

sentences.en: If he was capable of committing one brutal crime, did this also mean he'd committed the other?
sentences.zh: 如果他有能力犯下一起残暴的罪行，是否也意味着他犯下了另一桩？

sentences.en: The Asheville Police Department confirmed that Jason's arrest was a significant event for their investigation into Zeb's disappearance.
sentences.zh: 阿什维尔警察局证实，杰森的被捕对于他们调查泽布失踪案是一个重大的突破。

sentences.en: In a statement, Zeb's mother
sentences.zh: 在一份声明中，泽布的母亲

sentences.en: Denise asked the public not to overshadow Christy Schoen and JT Codd's heartbreaking deaths with statements, posts and questions about her son.
sentences.zh: 丹尼斯要求公众不要用关于她儿子的声明、帖子和提问来冲淡克里斯蒂·舍恩和杰特·科德令人心碎的离世。

sentences.en: Quote, We acknowledge and appreciate the abundant support we have always received from our friends and community and trust you will all give the Codd-Schoen families the same gift.
sentences.zh: 她说：“我们承认并感谢朋友和社区一直以来给予我们的大量支持，相信大家也会把同样的关爱送给科德-舍恩家族。”

sentences.en: Denise told reporters for the Asheville Citizen Times that while she viewed the Schoen-Cobb murders as totally separate from Zeb's case,
sentences.zh: 丹尼斯对《阿什维尔公民时报》的记者表示，虽然她认为舍恩-科德谋杀案与泽布的案子完全无关，

sentences.en: Quote,
sentences.zh: 但是，

sentences.en: I'm hopeful with what Jason Owens is facing, eventually whatever information he may have been holding back, he may decide to go ahead and let it go.
sentences.zh: “我希望随着杰森·欧文斯面临的审判，他最终可能会决定吐露他一直隐瞒的任何信息。”

sentences.en: But if Jason Owens intended to reveal anything about Zeb's disappearance, someone else beat him to it.
sentences.zh: 但如果杰森·欧文斯打算透露任何关于泽布失踪的信息，有人已经抢先了一步。

sentences.en: Ten days after Jason's arrest, his uncle Gene Owens contacted the police on his own volition.
sentences.zh: 在杰森被捕十天后，他的叔叔吉恩·欧文斯主动联系了警方。

sentences.en: Having heard how his nephew had disposed of JT and Christy's bodies, Gene told the police
sentences.zh: 在听说他的侄子是如何处理杰特和克里斯蒂的尸体后，吉恩告诉警方：

sentences.en: Maybe that's what happened to Zeb
sentences.zh: “也许泽布也是这样的下场。”

sentences.en: Gene told the police that back in 1999 there was an area on Jason Owen's property that Jason had dug out to burn things in
sentences.zh: 吉恩告诉警方，早在1999年，杰森·欧文斯的住所里有一片区域是杰森专门挖出来用来烧东西的，

sentences.en: Something Gene claimed Jason loved to do
sentences.zh: 吉恩称杰森非常喜欢干这种事，

sentences.en: The pit was approximately 8 feet long and 8 feet wide
sentences.zh: 这个坑大约长8英尺，宽8英尺。

sentences.en: Sometime after January 2000, the month that Zeb Quinn went missing, Jason allegedly filled the area with concrete, explaining that he was going to turn it into a fish pond instead.
sentences.zh: 在大约2000年1月（即泽布·奎因失踪的那个月）之后的某个时间，杰森据称用混凝土填满了这片区域，并解释说他要把这里改成一个鱼塘。

sentences.en: He then abandoned the project and covered the concrete with dirt instead.
sentences.zh: 随后他放弃了这个项目，并在混凝土上盖了一层泥土。

sentences.en: With that, a warrant was granted for police to search the property for Zeb's remains.
sentences.zh: 就这样，警方获得了一份搜查令，得以在搜查该物业以寻找泽布的遗骸。

sentences.en: several areas were excavated and the police managed to find fabric leather materials unknown hard fragments and several plastic bags filled with white powder
sentences.zh: 多个区域被挖掘，警方设法找到了织物皮革材料、未知的坚硬碎片以及几个装有白色粉末的塑料袋。

sentences.en: samples were tested but they revealed no indication of bone fragments or human remains
sentences.zh: 样本经过检测，但并未显示出任何骨骼碎片或人类遗骸的迹象。

sentences.en: meanwhile jason owens came forward with a story of his own jason claimed that his uncle
sentences.zh: 与此同时，杰森·欧文斯抛出了一套完全不同的说辞，声称他的叔叔

sentences.en: Jean was responsible for Zeb's murder and was throwing him under the bus to deflect attention from himself.
sentences.zh: 吉恩才是泽布谋杀案的幕后黑手，并将他推出来顶罪，以转移人们对自己的注意力。

sentences.en: After 15 years of silence, he was finally ready to tell the truth about what happened.
sentences.zh: 在沉默了15年之后，他终于准备好说出当年事情的真相了。

sentences.en: According to Jason, on the afternoon of Sunday January 2, 2000, Jean had asked him for a favour.
sentences.zh: 据杰森供述，在2000年1月2日星期日的下午，吉恩曾向他寻求一个帮忙。

sentences.en: Zeb's crush, Misty Taylor, apparently wanted to meet with Zeb without her jealous boyfriend Wesley Smith finding out.
sentences.zh: 泽布暗恋的女孩米斯蒂·泰勒显然想跟泽布见面，又不想让爱吃醋的男友韦斯利·史密斯发现。

sentences.en: Gene asked Jason if he could take Zeb out to Bent Creek, a forest roughly 10 miles from downtown Asheville, where Misty would be camping overnight.
sentences.zh: 吉恩问杰森能不能把泽布带到本特克里克，那是距离阿什维尔市中心大约10英里的一片森林，米斯蒂将在那里露营过夜。

sentences.en: Jason did as he was told.
sentences.zh: 杰森照办了。

sentences.en: After Zeb finished his shift at Walmart, the two headed out in their separate cars.
sentences.zh: 在泽布结束了沃尔玛的工作后，两人分别开车出发了。

sentences.en: According to Jason, when they got to Bent Creek, they found his uncle Gene parked on the side of the road.
sentences.zh: 据杰森所说，当他们到达本特克里克时，发现叔叔吉恩的车停在路边。

sentences.en: They all got out and Zeb asked Gene where Misty was.
sentences.zh: 他们都下了车，泽布问吉恩米斯蒂在哪里。

sentences.en: He responded that she'd be there any minute.
sentences.zh: 吉恩回答说她马上就到。

sentences.en: Zeb turned to keep an eye out, at which point
sentences.zh: 泽布转过身去环顾四周，就在这时，

sentences.en: Jason claimed that Gene reached into his truck, took out a .22 caliber rifle and shot Zeb in the back of the head.
sentences.zh: 杰森声称吉恩从他的卡车里拿出一支.22口径的步枪，朝泽布的后脑勺开了一枪。

sentences.en: In shock and fearing that he could be next, Jason jumped back into his truck.
sentences.zh: 杰森震惊万分，害怕下一个轮到自己，于是跳回了自己的卡车里。

sentences.en: But in his haste to speed off, he crashed into Zeb's car and his head slammed into the steering wheel.
sentences.zh: 但在急于加速逃跑时，他的车撞上了泽布的车，头部猛烈地撞在了方向盘上。

sentences.en: Gene ran over and assured Jason he wasn't going to hurt him.
sentences.zh: 吉恩跑过来向杰森保证，他不会伤害他。

sentences.en: Jason asked why he shot Zeb.
sentences.zh: 杰森问他为什么要射杀泽布。

sentences.en: Gene allegedly responded that Zeb had been putting his nose somewhere he shouldn't be and that someone needed to teach him a lesson.
sentences.zh: 吉恩据称回答说，泽布多管闲事插手不该管的事，必须有人给他点教训。

sentences.en: Gene warned Jason not to say a word to anyone, otherwise he'd go down as an accomplice to the murder.
sentences.zh: 吉恩警告杰森不准对任何人吐露半个字，否则他就会沦为谋杀案的同谋。

sentences.en: Terrified, Jason fled the scene, only to return later that night after he couldn't get to sleep.
sentences.zh: 杰森吓得魂飞魄散，逃离了现场，但由于无法入睡，当天深夜又折返回去。

sentences.en: A few hundred yards from the site of the shooting he claimed he saw a campfire burning.
sentences.zh: 他声称在距离枪击地点几百码的地方看到了一处燃烧的篝火。

sentences.en: His uncle Gene was tending to it and Zeb's feet were sticking out of the flames.
sentences.zh: 他的叔叔吉恩正在照看火堆，泽布的双脚从火焰中露了出来。

sentences.en: Gene forced Jason to stay with him overnight where he continued to feed Zeb's dismembered limbs to the fire.
sentences.zh: 吉恩强迫杰森留下来陪他过夜，并继续把泽布分尸后的四肢扔进火里烧掉。

sentences.en: Once his remains were cremated,
sentences.zh: 一旦遗骸被火化，

sentences.en: Jean put out the fire with water from the creek and scattered the ashes in the surrounding foreSt.
sentences.zh: 吉恩就用小溪里的水把火浇灭，并将骨灰撒在周围的森林里。

sentences.en: Jason was supposed to start work at the Volvo plant at 6am.
sentences.zh: 杰森本应在早上6点去沃尔玛的沃尔沃工厂上班。

sentences.en: Their employee policy stated that if a worker didn't show up without calling in beforehand, they'd lose their job.
sentences.zh: 他们的员工政策规定，如果员工不提前请假而旷工，就会失去工作。

sentences.en: Jean therefore told Jason to go to urgent care for the injuries he sustained when crashing into Zeb's car, as this would give him a valid reason for not showing up at work.
sentences.zh: 因此，吉恩告诉杰森去急诊室看因撞上泽布的车而受的伤，因为这能为他旷工提供一个正当的理由。

sentences.en: Too scared to speak out about what happened, Jason claimed he kept this to himself for 15 years, all the while wishing he could tell Zeb's family the truth about what happened.
sentences.zh: 由于太害怕而不敢说出事情的真相，杰森声称他把这个秘密保守了15年，期间一直希望能把真相告诉泽布的家人。

sentences.en: As for Zeb's Mazda reappearing at the Little Pigs BBQ restaurant,
sentences.zh: 至于泽布的马自达汽车为什么会重新出现在“小猪烧烤”餐厅，

sentences.en: Jason claimed this was as much of a mystery to him as anyone else.
sentences.zh: 杰森声称这对他来说和对其他人一样是个谜。

sentences.en: While Jason Owens gave this account to police, his uncle Gene Owens was interviewed in another room.
sentences.zh: 就在杰森·欧文斯向警方提供这番说辞的同时，他的叔叔吉恩·欧文斯正在另一间审讯室里接受盘问。

sentences.en: Gene had admitted to owning several firearms, most of which were .22 caliber rifles, but he claimed to know nothing about what happened to Zeb Quinn.
sentences.zh: 吉恩承认自己拥有几支枪械，其中大部分是.22口径的步枪，但他声称对泽布·奎因的遭遇一无所知。

sentences.en: Sensing his nephew might have implicated him,
sentences.zh: 意识到自己的侄子可能把他也牵连进去了，

sentences.en: Gene told the detectives that anything Jason Owens said was a lie.
sentences.zh: 吉恩告诉侦探，杰森·欧文斯说的一切都是谎言。

sentences.en: Investigators weren't willing to take any chances They headed out to Bent Creek, a densely vegetated area in Pisgah National Forest
sentences.zh: 调查人员不愿放过任何机会，他们带着杰森·欧文斯前往皮斯加国家森林中植被茂密、

sentences.en: known for its network of hiking trails, taking Jason Owens with them
sentences.zh: 以徒步小径网闻名的本特克里克地区。

sentences.en: Nothing of interest was found
sentences.zh: 但什么有价值的线索也没有找到。

sentences.en: If Jason's version of events was to be believed, this wasn't surprising given the amount of time that had passed
