sentences.zh: 如果相信杰森的版本，考虑到已经过去了那么长时间，这也并不让人意外。

sentences.en: Investigators remained sceptical
sentences.zh: 调查人员对此保持怀疑态度。

sentences.en: Firstly, the way Jason claimed his uncle had disposed of Zeb's remains bore remarkable similarities to the way he himself had disposed of JT and Christy's bodies.
sentences.zh: 首先，杰森声称他叔叔处理泽布遗骸的方式，与他自己处理杰特和克里斯蒂尸体的方式有着惊人的相似之处。

sentences.en: He'd also admitted to posing as Christy in text to her friends, just like he'd been caught doing in the phone call to Walmart just days after Zeb's disappearance.
sentences.zh: 他还承认曾模仿克里斯蒂给她的朋友发短信，正如他在泽布失踪几天后打给沃尔玛的电话中所做的那样。

sentences.en: In addition, investigators found inconsistencies in Jason Owen's story that cast doubt on its credibility.
sentences.zh: 此外，调查人员在杰森·欧文斯的说辞中发现了前后矛盾之处，这让人对其实际可信度产生了怀疑。

sentences.en: They therefore declined to speak with him any further about the matter.
sentences.zh: 因此，他们拒绝再就此事与他交谈。

sentences.en: But at the same time, some were perplexed by his admission.
sentences.zh: 但与此同时，一些人对他的供述感到困惑。

sentences.en: Jason hadn't asked for anything in exchange for his story, such as leniency of any kind in the Sean Cobb murders or immunity in Seb Quinn's case.
sentences.zh: 杰森在供述时并没有提出任何交换条件，比如在肖恩·科德谋杀案中获得宽大处理，或者在泽布·奎因案中获得豁免。

sentences.en: So if his version of events wasn't true, why make it up?
sentences.zh: 所以，如果他的版本不是真的，为什么要捏造呢？

sentences.en: Jason Owens' defence team investigated their client's claiMs.
sentences.zh: 杰森·欧文斯的辩护团队对他们当事人的说法展开了调查。

sentences.en: Jason agreed to undergo a polygraph test in which he stuck to his story that he watched his uncle, Gene Owens, shoot Zeb Quinn and burn his remains.
sentences.zh: 杰森同意接受测谎仪测试，在测试中他坚持了自己的说法：他亲眼看到叔叔吉恩·欧文斯枪杀泽布·奎因并焚烧其尸体。

sentences.en: The test showed no signs of deception.
sentences.zh: 测试结果显示没有说谎的迹象。

sentences.en: According to documents released by the defence, the police declined to disclose what alleged inconsistencies they found in Jason's story,
sentences.zh: 根据辩护方公布的文件，警方拒绝透露他们在杰森的说辞中发现了哪些所谓的矛盾之处，

sentences.en: nor did they give him a chance to address these inconsistencies.
sentences.zh: 也没有给他一个机会来解释这些矛盾。

sentences.en: The defence team looked into Gene Owens' background and found that he'd hovered suspiciously close to the Zeb Quinn disappearance.
sentences.zh: 辩护团队调查了吉恩·欧文斯的背景，发现他在泽布·奎因失踪案周围可疑地徘徊。

sentences.en: According to their findings, when Jason Owens was arrested for the high-speed chase back in 2002,
sentences.zh: 根据他们的调查结果，早在2002年杰森·欧文斯因高速追逐被捕时，

sentences.en: Gene appeared at his hospital bedside and cautioned the police not to ask his nephew anything about the Quinn matter.
sentences.zh: 吉恩曾出现在他的病床前，警告警察不要就奎因的事情向他侄子询问任何问题。

sentences.en: The defence also highlighted the questionable timing in which Gene Owens came forward with details about the fish pond on the Owens property.
sentences.zh: 辩护方还指出了吉恩·欧文斯主动提供欧文斯庄园鱼塘细节的时间点十分可疑。

sentences.en: Their findings revealed that the so-called fish pond had actually been dug up and turned into a retaining wall years before Zeb's disappearance,
sentences.zh: 他们的调查结果显示，这个所谓的鱼塘实际上在泽布失踪几年前就已经被挖开并改造成了一个挡土墙，

sentences.en: information that Gene was well aware of.
sentences.zh: 吉恩对这一信息心知肚明。

sentences.en: As far as the defence were concerned, with the Jason Owens arrested for the Show and Cobb murders,
sentences.zh: 在辩护方看来，随着杰森·欧文斯因肖恩和科德谋杀案被捕，

sentences.en: Gene was likely nervous that his nephew would finally be forthcoming with the truth about what happened to Zeb
sentences.zh: 吉恩很可能是担心他的侄子最终会吐露关于泽布遭遇的真相，

sentences.en: He therefore crafted the fishpond story to misdirect the investigation and to further discredit Jason
sentences.zh: 因此他精心编造了鱼塘的故事来误导调查，并进一步抹黑杰森。

sentences.en: There was also the lingering question of who set the fire to the trailer on the Owens property
sentences.zh: 还有一个挥之不去的问题是，究竟是谁放火烧了欧文斯庄园的拖车。

sentences.en: Jason and Gene had lived on the same property for many years
sentences.zh: 杰森和吉恩在同一处房产里住了多年，

sentences.en: Did someone other than Jason know something and feel compelled to destroy evidence?
sentences.zh: 除了杰森之外，是否还有其他人知道些什么，并感到有必要销毁证据？

sentences.en: Jason's lawyers defended his decision to remain silent for so long citing a combination of fear of his uncle and the fear that his story wouldn't be believed
sentences.zh: 杰森的律师为他长时间保持沉默的决定进行了辩护，理由是对他叔叔的恐惧以及担心自己的说法不被人相信，

sentences.en: a concern they found valid
sentences.zh: 他们认为这种担忧是合情合理的。

sentences.en: According to court documents, a former detective for the Asheville Police Department had confided in one of the defence lawyers, saying,
sentences.zh: 根据法庭文件，阿什维尔警察局的一名前侦探曾向其中一位辩护律师吐露心声，称：

sentences.en: Asheville Police had tunnel vision about the Zeb Quinn matter.
sentences.zh: 阿什维尔警方在泽布·奎因的事情上有狭隘的偏见。

sentences.en: They wanted to believe that Jason Owens killed Zeb, and they did not want to consider any other possibility.
sentences.zh: 他们宁愿相信是杰森·欧文斯杀害了泽布，绝不肯考虑任何其他可能性。

sentences.en: The district attorney allegedly told the defence team that they were prioritising the investigation into JT and Christy's murders
sentences.zh: 地方检察官据称曾告诉辩护团队，他们将优先调查杰特和克里斯蒂的谋杀案，

sentences.en: and would address the Quinn matter once the other case was closed.
sentences.zh: 并承诺一旦另一起案件侦破，就会着手处理奎因案。

sentences.en: Their main roadblock with the Schoen-Cod case was that Jason Owens had done such a thorough job of cremating their remains
sentences.zh: 他们在舍恩-科德案中遇到的大主要障碍是，杰森·欧文斯将他们的遗骸焚烧得极其彻底，

sentences.en: that investigators couldn't determine how the couple and their unborn child were killed.
sentences.zh: 以至于调查人员无法确定这对夫妇及其未出生的孩子是如何遇害的。

sentences.en: While they didn't believe a word of Jason's story about the car accident, with no contradicting evidence to suggest otherwise,
sentences.zh: 虽然他们对杰森关于车祸的供词一个字也不信，但在没有相反证据支持的情况下，

sentences.en: they felt the version of events he'd given was the closest they'd ever get to knowing what really happened.
sentences.zh: 他们认为他给出的这版陈述已经是他们能够了解到的最接近真相的还原了。

sentences.en: In April 2017, just over two years after JT, Christy and baby Skylar were killed, Jason Owens accepted a deal.
sentences.zh: 2017年4月，在杰特、克里斯蒂和婴儿斯凯拉遇害两年多后，杰森·欧文斯接受了一项认罪协议。

sentences.en: Maintaining the deaths had been an accident, he pleaded guilty to three counts of second-degree murder and two counts of dismembering human remains
sentences.zh: 在坚称死亡是一场意外的同时，他承认了三项二级谋杀罪和两项分解人类遗骸罪。

sentences.en: In exchange, the death penalty was taken off the table and he was sentenced to a minimum of 59 years and a maximum of 74, without the possibility of parole
sentences.zh: 作为交换，死刑被撤销，他被判处至少59年至最高74年的监禁，且不得假释。

sentences.en: A statement released by the district attorney said
sentences.zh: 地方检察官发表的一份声明称：

sentences.en: Because there are no surviving witnesses and Jason Owens had exclusive control of the crime scene for several days and he had nearly completed the gruesome project of cremating
sentences.zh: 由于没有幸存的目击者，且杰森·欧文斯在几天内独占了犯罪现场，几乎完成了火化受害者遗骸的恐怖工程，

sentences.en: his victim's remains, we will never know many of the facts surrounding the deaths.
sentences.zh: 我们永远无法得知围绕这些死亡事件的许多真相。

sentences.en: JT and Christy's loved ones had mixed feelings about the plea deal.
sentences.zh: JT和克里斯蒂的亲人们对认罪协议有着复杂的感情。

sentences.en: While they were relieved that Jason Owens had been held accountable and would be removed from society, they felt there was no punishment that fit his crime.
sentences.zh: 虽然他们松了一口气，因为杰森·欧文斯受到了应有的惩罚并被社会隔离，但他们觉得没有任何惩罚能配得上他的罪行。

sentences.en: In a statement, Christie's family said, we can only hope that he suffers for the remainder of his life on earth and again as he rots in hell.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂的家人在一份声明中表示，我们只能希望他在尘世余下的生命中饱受折磨，并在地狱中腐烂时再次遭受痛苦。

sentences.en: Less than two and a half months later, 66-year-old Gene Owens passed away from natural causes.
sentences.zh: 不到两个半月后，66岁的吉恩·欧文斯因自然原因离世。

sentences.en: He maintained his innocence in Zeb Quinn's disappearance until the bitter end.
sentences.zh: 直到生命的最后一刻，他依然坚称自己与泽布·奎因的失踪无关。

sentences.en: Two days later, and allegedly with no warning given to his lawyers, Jason Owens was formally charged with the first degree murder of Zeb Quinn.
sentences.zh: 两天后，在据称没有事先通知其律师的情况下，杰森·欧文斯被正式指控谋杀泽布·奎因一级谋杀罪。

sentences.en: He maintained that his uncle Gene was the real killer, but with Gene now gone and 17 years passing since Zeb's disappearance, it was Jason's word against a dead man.
sentences.zh: 他坚称自己的叔叔吉恩才是真正的凶手，但随着吉恩的离世以及距离泽布失踪已经过去了17年，这成了杰森与一个死无对证之人的各执一词。

sentences.en: One key element remained unclear.
sentences.zh: 有一个关键环节仍不清楚。

sentences.en: Gene Owens had no known link to Zeb
sentences.zh: 吉恩·欧文斯与泽布

sentences.en: Quinn, his crush Misty Taylor, or her boyfriend Wesley Smith.
sentences.zh: 奎因、他暗恋的对象米斯蒂·泰勒或她的男友韦斯利·史密斯之间没有已知的联系。

sentences.en: As such, Gene had no reason to lure Zeb out to the forest under the guise of having a rendezvous with Misty just to murder him.
sentences.zh: 因此，吉恩没有理由以与米斯蒂约会的幌子把泽布引诱到树林里并将其谋杀。

sentences.en: As revealed in the documentary A Good Kid, Jason claimed to know the missing piece of the puzzle, and that missing piece was a man named Adam Wright.
sentences.zh: 正如纪录片《好孩子》中所揭示的那样，杰森声称自己知道这块拼图缺失的最后一块，而那块缺失的拼图是一个名叫亚当·赖特的人。

sentences.en: According to Jason, it was Adam Wright who introduced his uncle Gene to Wesley Smith.
sentences.zh: 据杰森所说，正是亚当·赖特将他的叔叔吉恩介绍给了韦斯利·史密斯。

sentences.en: While Jason didn't know the circumstances of their relationship, he assumed that Wesley had told Gene about Zeb's unwanted affection towards Misty.
sentences.zh: 虽然杰森并不知道他们关系的具体情况，但他推测韦斯利一定把泽布对米斯蒂的非分之想告诉了吉恩。

sentences.en: Gene had agreed to remove Zeb from the picture.
sentences.zh: 吉恩同意将泽布从这个世界上除掉。

sentences.en: In a prison interview, Jason told the producers of A Good Kid that the motive had to be money.
sentences.zh: 在一次狱中采访中，杰森告诉《好孩子》的制作人，动机一定是为了钱。

sentences.en: He said,
sentences.zh: 他说，

sentences.en: This story raised one more problem.
sentences.zh: 这个说法引发了另一个问题。

sentences.en: Adam Wright had passed away from a drug overdose in 2010.
sentences.zh: 亚当·赖特已于2010年因药物过量离世。

sentences.en: There was no one left to vouch for Jason Owen's version of events.
sentences.zh: 已经没有人能为杰森·欧文斯的说法作证了。

sentences.en: Law enforcement remained unconvinced by Jason's assertions, but there was no physical evidence to confirm otherwise.
sentences.zh: 执法部门对杰森的说辞依然半信半疑，但没有物证来证实相反的情况。

sentences.en: Without something to present to a jury, they knew that securing a murder conviction would be a challenge.
sentences.zh: 在没有证据提交给陪审团的情况下，他们知道要稳操胜券将谋杀罪名定案将是一个挑战。

sentences.en: Eventually, in July 2022, prosecutors and Zeb's family agreed to a plea deal.
sentences.zh: 最终，在2022年7月，检察官与泽布的家人达成了一项认罪协议。

sentences.en: Jason Owens pleaded guilty to accessory after the fact of first degree murder in exchange for an additional 13 years in prison
sentences.zh: 杰森·欧文斯对一级谋杀罪作出的窝藏罪行供认不讳，以此换取被追加判处13年监禁。

sentences.en: The district attorney acknowledged that while many unanswered questions remained at least the plea brought some form of closure to the Quinn family
sentences.zh: 地方检察官承认，虽然仍有许多未解之谜，但这项认罪协议至少给奎因一家带来了一种形式上的了结。

sentences.en: after over two decades of not knowing for sure if Zeb was alive or dead In a statement, the district attorney said
sentences.zh: 在经历了两十多年来无法确定泽布是生是死之后，地方检察官在一份声明中表示：

sentences.en: While we may never know the full truth these many years after Zeb's disappearance, my sympathies are with the family and all who have suffered as a result.
sentences.zh: 虽然在泽布失踪多年后的今天，我们可能永远无法得知全部真相，但我的同情与他的家人以及所有因此遭受痛苦的人同在。

sentences.en: Although Misty Taylor and Wesley Smith were questioned by investigators several times over
sentences.zh: 尽管米斯蒂·泰勒和韦斯利·史密斯多年来曾多次接受调查人员的盘问，

sentences.en: the years, they have never been formally considered persons of interest in Zeb Quinn's disappearance.
sentences.zh: 但他们从未被正式列为泽布·奎因失踪案的涉案嫌疑人。

sentences.en: The mysterious page Zeb received from his aunt's house on the night of his murder has never been explained.
sentences.zh: 在他遇害当晚，泽布从他姑姑家收到那个神秘传呼至今仍未得到解释。

sentences.en: Some believe that the police were too focused on Jason Owens from the get-go, and that a more resourceful police department could have done a better job of
sentences.zh: 有人认为，警方从一开始就过分聚焦于杰森·欧文斯，如果是一个资源更丰富的警察局，本可以把

sentences.en: exploring other leads, especially given the many clues left behind in Zeb's abandoned vehicle.
sentences.zh: 追查其他线索的工作做得更好，特别是考虑到泽布被遗弃的汽车里留下了许多线索。

sentences.en: Who left the car there and why is a question that will likely never be answered.
sentences.zh: 是谁把车停在那里的以及原因是什么，这个问题可能永远不会有答案。

sentences.en: Jason Owens' lawyer told the documentary A Good Kid, quote,
sentences.zh: 杰森·欧文斯的律师在纪录片《好孩子》中表示，原话是：

sentences.en: Gene Owens was the killer.
sentences.zh: 吉恩·欧文斯就是凶手。

sentences.en: We don't doubt that.
sentences.zh: 对此我们深信不疑。

sentences.en: Gene Owens was the killer, and he's dead.
sentences.zh: 吉恩·欧文斯是凶手，而且他已经死了。

sentences.en: And whatever the arrangements were for Gene to kill Zeb Quinn, those people have never been charged.
sentences.zh: 无论吉恩杀死泽布·奎因的安排是怎样的，那些人都从未被起诉过。

sentences.en: Others believe that Jason Owens is a compulsive liar who acted alone.
sentences.zh: 另一些人则认为，杰森·欧文斯是一个独来独往的强迫性说谎者。

sentences.en: Whatever the truth, it's a commonly held belief that if Jason hadn't been caught for the murders
sentences.zh: 无论真相如何，人们普遍认为，如果杰森没有因谋杀

sentences.en: of JT, Christy, and their unborn child, Zeb Quinn's case would likely still be unsolved.
sentences.zh: JT、克里斯蒂以及他们未出生的孩子而被捕，泽布·奎因的案件很可能至今仍未破获。

sentences.en: Some have criticised the courts for accepting Jason Owen's plea deals in both cases.
sentences.zh: 一些人批评法院在两起案件中都接受了杰森·欧文斯的认罪协议。

sentences.en: Given that prosecutors didn't fully believe his version of events, it raises the question of whether or not justice has truly been served for his victiMs.
sentences.zh: 鉴于检察官并未完全相信他的说辞，这就引发了一个问题：为他的受害者伸张正义了吗？

sentences.en: Christy's family are convinced that Jason didn't act alone in JT and Christy's deaths.
sentences.zh: 克里斯蒂的家人确信在JT和克里斯蒂的遇害事件中，杰森并不是一个人作案。

sentences.en: either.
sentences.zh: 亦是如此。

sentences.en: In their statement after his plea deal was accepted, they said,
sentences.zh: 在他们的认罪协议被接受后发表的声明中，他们说道：

sentences.en: Although we know deep down that others in his family hold responsibility for these heinous murders, there is not much we can do in terms of justice for them.
sentences.zh: 虽然我们内心深处知道他家族中的其他人也对这些滔天谋杀负有责任，但在为他们伸张正义方面，我们能做的不多。

sentences.en: We will attempt to heal and let go of some of the anger that we still have.
sentences.zh: 我们将努力愈合伤痛，并放下我们心中残存的一些愤怒。

sentences.en: We also have to say that we are so lucky to have met some of the most wonderful people through this tragedy.
sentences.zh: 我们还必须说，通过这场悲剧，我们非常幸运地结识了一些最棒的人。

sentences.en: Those people are the family of
sentences.zh: 那些人就是

sentences.en: Zeb Quinn.
sentences.zh: 泽布·奎因的家人。

sentences.en: This family deserves just as much healing, peace and closure as we do, and we can only hope they get a little bit of that.
sentences.zh: 这个家庭理应得到和我们一样多的疗愈、平静和了结，我们只能希望他们能得到一丝宽慰。

sentences.en: The Quinn family asked for privacy in the wake of
sentences.zh: 在杰森·欧文斯的认罪协议达成之后，奎因一家要求保护隐私，但在他的听证会上，

sentences.en: Jason Owen's plea deal, but at his hearing, Zeb's mother Denise spoke about her son's belief that you should always try to see the best in people.
sentences.zh: 泽布的母亲丹妮丝谈到了她儿子生前的信念，即你应当永远试着去看清他人最好的一面。

sentences.en: She reflected on a time when Zeb was in high school and she wasn't happy about some of the people he chose to hang around with.
sentences.zh: 她回想起泽布上高中时的一段时光，当时她对儿子选择结交的一些朋友很不满意。

sentences.en: Denise warned her son that he would be judged by the company he kept.
sentences.zh: 丹妮丝曾警告她的儿子，观其友则知其人。

sentences.en: She told the court, quote,
sentences.zh: 她对法庭说道，原话是：

sentences.en: Zeb looked back at me and said,
sentences.zh: 泽布回过头看着我说：

sentences.en: They have done nothing wrong to me and have done nothing wrong around me and I will continue to be their friend.
sentences.zh: 他们没有对做过任何对不起我的事，也没有在我周围做过任何坏事，我会继续做他们的朋友。

sentences.en: This is the young man that was taken from his family, friends, community and the world.
sentences.zh: 这就是那个被从他的家人、朋友、社区以及整个世界身边夺走的年轻人。

sentences.en: This is a young man that never would have seen his end coming.
sentences.zh: 这就是那个绝不会料到自己会遭遇如此结局的年轻人。

sentences.en: This is the young man who trusted his friend,
sentences.zh: 这就是那个信任他朋友的年轻人，

sentences.en: Jason.
sentences.zh: 杰森。
